yathā puṇyaṃ prasavate pareṣāṃ bhojanaṃ dadat | na tu svayaṃ sa bhuñjānas tathā puṇyamahodayaḥ
aṅgulipratodanam (aguliprabhodānam)
na muṇḍitena śramaṇo na bhoḥ kāreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ | yasya satyaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca brāhmaṇaḥ śramaṇaḥ sa ca

putri kātra yuktiḥ | tāta etāni śūnyadevakulāni nityam eva viṭavātaputradhūrtakair aśūnyāni |yadi mama praviṣṭāyā kaścid aṃgapratyaṃgāni parāmṛśati nanv evaṃ mātāpitror me ayaśasyatā bhavati |varam abhyavakāśe prāṇaviyogaḥ | na tv eva śūnyadevakulapraveśaḥ |
śuddhā trimaṇḍaleneti | yena ca deśayati vācā padaiś ca | yathā coddeśādiprakāraiḥ | yeṣu codghaṭitavipañcitajñeṣu | eṣaiva ca deśanā punar aṣṭadoṣavivarjitā veditavyā yathākramaṃ |
hṛṣṭaś caiva sahasrākṣo devarājaḥ śacīpatiḥ | pragrahīṣyati kumāraṃ taṃ dvātriṃśalakṣṇānvitam | śriyā jvalantaṃ maitreyaṃ mātur haste pradāsyati
na vidyate yasya cāśā hy asmin loke parāpi ca | nirāśiṣaṃ visamyuktaṃ bravīmi brāhmaṇaṃ hi tam
vajracchedikā prajñāpāramitā samāptāḥ || | ||
tvadrūpam iva (r)ūpāṇāṃ tvaccittam iva cetasām | tvaddharma i(va dharmāṇā)m agryaḥ prāṇabhṛtām asi
ta evādhvā kathāvastu saniḥsārāḥ savastukāḥ
yāvad vijñaptimātratve vijñānaṃ nāvatiṣṭhati | grāhadvayasyānuśayastāvan na vinivartate
satveṣu hitakāritvān naity āpattiṃ sa rāgajāṃ | dveṣo virudyate tvasya sarvasatveṣu satpathā
tathāgatasya dānaśīlakṣāntivīryadhyānaprajñāpāramitā, bhadanta śāradvatīputrākṣayās, tad bodhicittaṃ teṣāṃ mūlam utpādyate, tasmād akṣayam;
hīnāṃ dharmāṃ na seveta pramādena na saṃvaset | mithyā dṛṣṭiṃ na roceta na bhavel loka vardhanaḥ
vyākhyātaṃ śravaṇaṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ sparśanaṃ manaḥ | darśanenaiva jānīyāc chrotṛśrotavyakādi ca
na te ’sti sadṛśaḥ kaś cid adhike vākpatho ’sti kaḥ | alpāntarāvakṛṣṭo ’pi na te kaś cana vidyate
katham anenākāśadṛṣṭāntena tathāgatadhātor aśuddhāvasthāyām avikāradharmatā paridīpitā | tad ucyate |

tatra katamaḥ sa tathāgatagarbhaśūnyatārthanaya ucyate | nāpaneyam ataḥ kiṃcid upaneyaṃ na kiṃcana | draṣṭavyaṃ bhūtato bhūtaṃ bhūtadarśī vimucyate śūnya āgantukair dhātuḥ savinirbhāgalakṣaṇaiḥ | aśūnyo anuttarair dharmair avinirbhāgalakṣaṇaiḥ
viṣamo ’yam upanyāsaḥ
athāpareṇa samayena sa sārthavāhaḥ paṇyaṃ visarjayitvāgataḥ |
ārya pītaṃ ghṛtam |
tatra ye āṣāḍhyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyāṃ saṃnipatanti te tāṃs tān uddeśayogamanasikārān udgṛhya paryavāpya tāsu tāsu grāmanagaranigamarāṣṭrarājadhānīṣu varṣām upagacchanti |
kiṃ cānyat | yadi svataś ca pramāṇasiddhir anapekṣya tava prameyāṇi | bhavati pramāṇasiddhir na parāpekṣā svataḥ siddhiḥ
baler mahendraṃ nahuṣaṃ mahendrād indraṃ punar ye nahuṣād upeyuḥ | svarge kṣitau vā viṣayeṣu teṣu ko viśvased bhāgyakulākuleṣu
śūnyatāyāṃ viśuddhāyāṃ nairātmyān mārgalābhataḥ | buddhāḥ śuddhātmalābhitvāt gatā ātmamahātmatām
sāraṃ tu sārato jñātvā hy asāraṃ cāpy asārataḥ | te sāram adhigacchanti samyak saṃkalpagocarāḥ

āgatir iti, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, vijñaptimukhalakṣaṇam etat, gatir iti, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, vijñaptimukhakṣayalakṣaṇam etat. yatra na vijñaptimukhalakṣaṇaṃ na vijñaptimukhakṣayalakṣaṇam, tatra nāgatir na gatir, anāgatir agatiś cāryāṇāṃ gatiḥ.
varṇārhavarṇe buddhastotre avivādastavo nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paricchedaḥ
samantāloko nāma samādhiḥ
alpakaṃ pi kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ paraloke sukhāvaham | arthāya mahate nityaṃ sasyānām iva saṃcayaḥ
skandhānām eṣa saṃtāno yasmād dīpārciṣām iva | tasmān nānantavattvaṃ ca nāntavattvaṃ ca yujyate
svapāpasmṛtisaṃtaptaḥ śṛṇvannādāṃś ca nārakān | trāsoccāraviliptāṅgo vihvalaḥ kiṃ kariṣyasi
śāstā cāsya tathāgato ’rhan samyaksambuddhaḥ
imāni, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, bodhisattvānāṃ pañcākṣayāṇīndriyāṇi.
kāṅkṣā hi yā syād iha vā pṛthag veha vedikā vā paravedikā vā | tāṃ dhyāyino viprajahanti sarvā hy ātāpino brahmacaryaṃ carantaḥ
saṅgāt pramukto hy asita ājñātāvī niraupadhiḥ | atikramya māraviṣayaṃ ādityo vā virocate
vināśayati durjñāto dharmo ’yam avipaścitam | nāstitādṛṣṭisamale yasmād asmin nimajjati
dadanti dānāni mam evarūpā vividhāni citrāṇi ca harṣajātāḥ | datvā ca bodhāya janenti vīryaṃ dānena te prasthita agrabodhim
cakṣurādīni pañca varttamānaviṣayatvāt pūrvam uktāni | manas tv aniyataviṣayamkiñcid varttamānaviṣayaṃ kiñcit vyadhvānadhraviṣayam |
aparasya kṣiptam ayoguḍaṃ bhakṣayitum ārabdhaḥ | aparasya kṣiptaṃ svamāṃsaṃ bhakṣayitum ārabdhaḥ |
svayaṃbhuve namas te ’stu prabhūtādbhutakarmaṇe | yasya saṃkhyāprabhāvābhyāṃ na guṇeṣv asti niścayaḥ
rājā paraṃ vismayam āpanna amātyānāṃ kathayati | bhavato jīvakasya vaidyarājābhiṣekaṃ kuruteti |
āśayasya ca māhātmyaṃ na svataḥ kiṃ tu kāryataḥ | samaṃ ca tena māhātmyaṃ sattvānāṃ tena te samāḥ

(yaḥ kaścit kūlaputro vā kuladuhitā vā asyāṃ gambhīrāyaṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caryāṃ cartukāmas tena kathaṃ śikṣitavyam? evam ukta Āryaavalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo āyuṣmantaṃ Sāriputraṃ etad avocat:
satvān ameyān paripācanāya kṣetrasya śuddhasya ca sādhanāya
dharmameghā dvayavyāpter dharmākāśasya meghavat
lokāvatāraṇārthaṃ ca bhāvā nāthena deśitāḥ | tattvataḥ kṣaṇikā naite saṃvṛtyā ced virudhyate
pāruṣyāt prativiratiḥ
cirasyādya narāditya īdṛśīṃ kurute kathām | balā vimokṣā dhyānāś ca aprameyā mi sparśitāḥ
pañca rūpādayaḥ skandhā ity uktam | tatra
deveṣu ca manujeṣu ca nityaṃ saṃjāyate ca budhaḥ
anvabhuṅkthā yad asyārthe jagato vyasanaṃ bahu | tat saṃsmṛtya virūpe ’pi stheyaṃ te śāsane bhavet
rātrau yathā meghaghanāndhakāre vidyut kṣaṇaṃ darśayati prakāśam | buddhānubhāvena tathā kadācil lokasya puṇyeṣu matiḥ kṣaṇaṃ syāt
nairyāṇikaḥ saṃbodhigāmī
śrāmaṇye carate yas tu sva cittam anivārayet | punaḥ punar viṣīdet sa saṃkalpānāṃ vaśaṃ gataḥ
katame aṣṭau | ya ete sapratighā daśoktāḥ |
mokṣe nātmā na ca skandhā mokṣaś ced īdṛśaḥ priyaḥ | ātmaskandhāpanayanaṃ kim ihaiva na te priyam
śāstrajñatā hi dhīrāṇāṃ samādhimukhadhāraṇī | gṛhītā satvapākāya saddharmasya ca dhāraṇe
ālokakaro nāma samādhiḥ
antaroddānaṃ || yathāgantyā ca jñaptiś ca | sāmagrī maṇḍalakaś ca
bodhiś caryā śruta cātra śamatho ’tha vipaśyanā | śraddhādīnāṃ padaṃ jñeyamarthasiddhyadhikārataḥ
yāvad asau sārthavāhaḥ saṃpannārthe rājagṛhasamīpam āgataḥ |tena patnyādi saṃdiṣṭaṃ bhadre prāmodyam utpādaya |svastitaḥ saṃpannārtho ’ham āgataḥ |kiyat tamair divasair āgata eveti |
ārya na śobhanaṃ kṛtam | adya dviguṇaṃ pibeti |
nūnaṃ ca buddhis tava nātisūkṣmā dharmārthakāmeṣv avicakṣaṇā vā | hetor adṛṣṭasya phalasya yas tvaṃ pratyakṣam arthaṃ paribhūya yāsi
prapātaṃ bhavati |bhagavān āha | vedikā parikṣeptavyā |
tataḥ sa paryaṅkam akampyam uttamaṃ babandha suptoragabhogapiṇḍitam | bhinadmi tāvad bhuvi naitad āsanaṃ na yāmi yāvat kṛtakṛtyatām iti
samudaye ’nvayajñānakṣāntiḥ
tatra katamā pravṛttiḥ? yā bodhyaṅgasamudānayatā. tatra katamā sthitiḥ? yā dharmapravicayajñānakauśalyajñānatā.
vaḍavā nāvaṃ nābhirohati |
āha: dṛṣṭaṃ bhagavan |
nasādhikapauruṣyaṃ vṛkṣam adhirokṣyāma anyatrāpada iti śikṣā karaṇīyā
ārabhadhvaṃ niṣkramadhvaṃ yujyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane | dhunidhvaṃ mṛtyunaḥ sainyaṃ naḍāgāram iva kuñjaraḥ
yatra punar vastuni rūpādisaṃjñake prajñaptiḥ pudgala iti tasmāt kim ekatvena pudgalo vaktavya āhosvid anyatvena | āha |
samudraviṣṭāś ca bhavanti sarvā ekāśrayā ekamahājalāś ca | miśraikakāryāś ca mahopabhogyā jalāśritaprāṇigaṇasya nityam
rūkṣam (rukṣam)
evam anya thā ca sā sārthavāhapatnī kṣudhāparigatahṛdayātmānam anuśocantī tiṣṭhati ||
caturbhir ebhi(r) nidhibhiḥ sa rājā susamanvitaḥ | bhaviṣyati mahāvīraḥ śatapuṇyaphalārpitaḥ
dvivācikāyāṃ pravāraṇāyāṃ prathamāyāṃ vāci bhāṣyamāṇāyām aparyavasitāyāyāṃ pravāraṇāṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ pravāraṇāsthāpanam.
pratyahaṃ pañcarātram vā baddhān kṣīṇān vimocaya | śeṣān api yathāyogaṃ mā kāṃś cin naiva mocaya
yāṃ buddho bhāṣate vācaṃ kṣemāṃ nirvāṇaprāptaye | duhkhasyāntakriyā yuktāṃ sā hi vāk sādhu bhāṣitā
iha śayyāgatenāpi bandhumadhye ’pi tiṣṭhatā | mayaivaikena soḍhavyā marmacchedādivedanā
“āyur ūṣmātha vijñānaṃ yadā kāyaṃ jahaty amī | apaviddhas tadā śete yathā kāṣṭham acetana” iti ||

vijñānam iti vijñānaṃ catuḥsthānam.katamāni catvāri?tad yathā vijñānanasthānāni rūpopagavedanopagasaṃjñopagasaṃskāropagasthānāni, idaṃ vijñānam.tatra katamaj jñānam? yac catuḥskandhasthitasya vijñānaskandhasya parijñānam, idam jñānam.
atha khalu vajragarbho bodhisattva āsāṃ daśānāṃ bodhisattvabhūmīnāṃ nāmadheyamātraṃ parikīrtya tūṣṇīṃ babhūva, na bhūyaḥ prabhedaśo nirdiśati sma |
tasmā hu nāmapariṇāmana śikṣitavyā yatha te jinā kuśala eva prajānayanti | yajjātiyo ’yaṃ prabhavo yadalakṣaṇaṃ ca anumodamī tatha tathā pariṇāmayāmi
/// viditvā gāthāṃ bhāṣete ||
staimityaṃ viklavībhāvo ’pratisaṃkhyānarogajaḥ | ātmopakaraṇe hīne nidrāsaṅgo ’lasasya vā
āgantuko bhadanta bhikṣur na gocarakuśalo bhavati na vīthīkuśalaḥ | sa madīyaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhujya gocarakuśalo bhaviṣyati | vīthīkuśalaś ca |
āgārikatvaṃ pratijānāti pūrvavad yāvad asaṃvāsikatvaṃ pratijānāti | ānītā pāriśuddhir vaktavyā | anānītā |anānītā upāliṃ punar apy ānayitavyā | ||
kāryaṃ kasya na cet sattvaḥ satyam īhā tu mohataḥ | duḥkhavyupaśamārthaṃ tu kāryamoho na vāryate

daśakuśalakarmapathapariśuddhiḥ kulaputra bodhisatvasya buddhakṣetram, tasya bodhiprāptasya niyatāyuṣo mahābhogā brahmacāriṇaḥ satyānuparivartinyā vācālaṃkṛtā madhuravacanā abhinnaparṣado bhinnasaṃdhānakuśalā īrṣyāvigatā avyāpannacittāḥ samyagdṛṣṭisamanvāgatāḥ satvā buddhakṣetre saṃbhavanti |
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ ta iha śikṣita vādiśreṣṭhā gamayanti dharma nikhilāniha śūnyatāyām | yāṃ śrutva śrāvaka spṛśanti vimukti śīghraṃ pratyekabodhi spṛśayanti ca buddhabodhim
tenobhayapārśvayoḥ patramukhāni dattāni | tathāpy anupātaṃ vinā na śobhate ity anupāto dattaḥ |
rūpārūpyeṣv akuśalād anyatra
kiṅkiṇījālamukharaḥ (kikaṇījālaṃ, mukhalā, mukharā)
pohalam, popphalam
yathāpi tad vihāraḥ dāvamadhye pratiṣṭhāpito bhavati. pūrvavad yāvat sa tasmād āvāsāt prakrāmaty. etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā anāpattir varṣācchede //
ataḥ paraṃ ye ca balādayo yathā cānugantavyās tathatām adhikṛtya granthaḥ |
tatra katamaḥ samyagājīvaḥ?
dhyānaṃ ca kuśalaṃ nityaṃ prajñā caivāvikalpikā | vijñeyā bodhisatvānāṃ tāsv eva samacittatā
“vāraṇa tvam upagamya pāṇḍaraṃ ṣaḍviṣāṇaruciraṃ catuṣkramam | mātṛgarbhaśayanaṃ viśeṣasaṃprajānanṛṣirāśramaṃ yatheti” ||
apy evāpratighe vyomni kaś cid utpādayed vraṇam | na tv asyāṃ dharmamu(drā)yāṃ sahadharmeṇa kaś cana
ātmadharmopacāro hi vividho yaḥ pravartate | vijñānapariṇāme ’sau pariṇāmaḥ sa ca tridhā
koḍhakaḥ (khoḍakaḥ, khoṭakaḥ)
na pādukārūḍhāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāmi (na pādakarūḍhāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāmi)
prāptāprāptavihāniṃ śuklair dharmaiḥ samāpnute tena |

apareṇa samayena mṛgārasya puruṣavyādhir utpannaḥ |viśākhā asyopasthānaṃ karoti | sa jihreti |sā kathayati | tāta kimarthaṃ jihreṣi |kiṃ na duhitā pitur upasthānaṃ karoti |tathāpy asau jihreti |sā saṃlakṣayati | nāyaṃ mamāntikād upasthānaṃ svīkaroti |dārasaṃgraham asya karomīti |
atha jīvako vaidyarājo bhagavata pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavato ’ntikāt prakrāntaḥ |
dharmālambanalābhaḥ syāt tribhir jñānaiḥ śrutādibhiḥ | trividhālambanalābhaś ca pūrvoktas tat samāśritaḥ
anena maṇinā chanda praṇamya bahuśo nṛpaḥ | vijñāpyo ’muktaviśrambhaṃ saṃtāpavinivṛttaye
anucintayitvā bahukalpakoṭyo gaṅgā yathā vālika aprameyāḥ | ananyacittāḥ sukhumāya prajñayā teṣāṃ pi cāsmin viṣayo na vidyate
etena hetv abhāvaḥ pratyuktaḥ pūrvam eva sa samatvāt | mṛgatṛṣṇādṛṣṭāntavyāvṛttividhau ya uktaḥ prāk
sa kathayati | naṣṭo ’yaṃ bhadanta lokaḥ pranaṣṭo ’yam |yathā nakṣatrāṇi vyavasthitāni dvādaśabhir varṣaiḥ |
makaro nāgarājā
marīcyupamaṃ cittam viviktam atyantavivekatayeyam ucyate cittadharmatā,yat punaḥ sarvakuśalamūlavīryārambhān sarvabuddhadharmaparipūraye pariṇāmayatīyam ucyate viṭhapanā.
saṃpūrṇabhogo na tathāstimantam ātmānam anvīkṣati yācako ’pi | sarvastidānād adhano ’pi dhīmān ātmānam anveti yathāstimantaṃ
yān dharmān śraddhendriyeṇa śraddadhāti, tān dharmān vīryendriyeṇa samudānayatīdam ucyate vīryendriyam.
sa kathayaty aham api na jāne | api tu mayā caiṣa kāṣṭhabhārako gṛhīto bhavati | mama cedṛśī samavasthā iti |
maitreyavyākaraṇaṃ samāptam ||
saci gaṅgavālukasamāni sthihitva kalpāṃ sattveti śabda parikīrtayi nāyako ’yam | sattvasy’ upādu kutu bheṣyati ādiśuddho eṣā sa prajñavarapāramitāya caryā
ādarśamukho nāgarājā
na kiṃcid asti tad vastu yad abhyāsasya duṣkaram | tasmān mṛduvyathābhyāsāt soḍhavyāpi mahāvyathā
anābhoga nirāsaṅga avyāghāta samāhita | sadaiva sarvapraśnānāṃ visarjaka namo ’stu te
sa kathayati | bhavanto mayā yuṣmākaṃ paṃcaśatāni marmaṇi tāḍitāny avaśiṣṭaṃ jīvitenācchādayāmi nivartateti |

buddho bhagavāṃ kauśāmbyāṃ viharati ghoṣilārāme |tena khalu samayenāyuṣmāṃ chanda āpattim āpanno na paśyati |etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti |bhagavān āha | kuruta yūyaṃ bhikṣavaḥ chandasya bhikṣor āpatter adarśanāyotkṣepaṇīyaṃ karma iti yo vā punar anyo ’py evaṃjātīyaḥ |
sarve rutā ekarutā prajānata na bheti nānātva kadācit asya | mayā pi te bhāṣita tīrthadharmā ubhau samā dharmata tulyaprāptāḥ
kṣāntīye vimukhā bālāḥ kusīdā hīnavīryakāḥ | anavasthitacittāś ca duḥprajñā jaḍamomuhāḥ ||
uktaṃ bhagavatā bhikṣuṇā varṣā upagantavyam iti. bhikṣavo na jānate kathaṃ varṣā upagantavyam iti.

yac caturaśītidharmaskandhapravicayajñānam.ye dharmā yathā yathā pravicetavyā nītārthaś ca nītārtho, neyārthaś ca neyārthaḥ, saṃvṛtyarthaś ca saṃvṛtyarthaḥ, paramārthaś ca paramārthaḥ, saṃkeṭaś ca saṃkeṭo, viniścitaś ca viniścitaḥ, tān tān dharmān tathā pravicinoti.
nānātvakāyā ekatvasaṃjñinas tadyathā devā brahmakāyikāḥ prathamābhinirvṛttāḥ
yaḥ sāsravair dharmair visaṃyogaḥ sa pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ |duḥkhādīnām āryasatyānāṃ pratisaṃkhyānaṃ pratisaṃkhyā prajñāviśeṣas tena prāpyo nirodhaḥ pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ |madhyapadalopāt gorathavat |
samayo ’sya niveśanadharmaṃ kartum
svayaṃ kṛtaṃ parakṛtaṃ dvābhyāṃ kṛtam ahetukam | duḥkham ity eka icchanti tac ca kāryaṃ na yujyate
na pātrasaṃdhunakam
tena sattvaparo bhūtvā kāye ’smin yad yad īkṣase | tat tad evāpahṛtyāsmāt parebhyo hitam ācara
rūpadhātau caturdaśa dhātavaḥ |
tasmāc chubhaṃ durbalam eva nityaṃ balaṃ tu pāpasya mahat sughoram | taj jīyate ’nyena śubhena kena saṃbodhicittaṃ yadi nāma na syāt
animitte ’py anābhogaḥ kṣetrasya ca viśodhanā | satvapākasya niṣpattir jāyate ca tataḥ param
matkarmacoditā eva jātā mayy apakāriṇaḥ | yena yāsyanti narakān mayaivāmī hatā nanu
prāptāḥ kṣepāvṛtāḥ sevā veṣabhāṣāntaraṃ kṛtam | nātha vaineyavātsalyāt prabhuṇāpi satā tvayā
pariśuddhajīvas tathāgataḥ, nāsti tathāgatasyāpariśuddhajīvatā
prāptyā saha satvākhyam evotpadyate nānyad iti vikalpārtho vā śabdaḥ |
imāv api candrasūryau evammaharddhikau evaṃ mahānubhāvau evaṃ mahaujaskau pāṇinā parāmṛṣati parimārjayati
tatra katamā pravṛttiḥ? yā kṣāntyadhivāsanatā. tatra katamā sthitiḥ? yā cittāvraṇatā.
pūjayaty arthamānair yān ye ’pi cainaṃ samāśritāḥ | te ’py enaṃ hantum icchanti svāminaṃ dveṣadurbhagam
prasrabhya cittasaṃskārān praśvasan prasrabhya cittasaṃskārān praśvasāmīti yathābhūtaṃ prajānāti
kiṃ cānyat | yadi ca svaparātmānau tvadvacanena prakāśayaty agniḥ | pracchādayiṣyati tamaḥ svaparātmānau hutāśa iva
paśya citrakṛtaṃ bimbaṃ maṇibhiḥ kuṇḍalais tathā | alaṃ bālasya mohāya na tu pāragaveṣiṇām
mātaṅgyām akṣamālāyāṃ garhitāyāṃ riraṃsayā | kapiñjalādaṃ tanayaṃ vasiṣṭho ’janayan muniḥ
ucchinnabhavatṛṣṇasya vastuc chinnasya bhikṣuṇaḥ | vikṣīṇo jāti saṃsāro mukto ’sau māra bandhanāt
apramādarato bhikṣuḥ pramāde bhayadarśakaḥ | samyojanam aṇu sthūlaṃ dahann agnir iva gacchati
sabhāgaḥ sarvabuddhānām asaṃkīrṇāryavaṃśajaḥ | varṇaprajñāvabhāsābhyām avabhāsyodito diśaḥ
gṛhapatiḥ kathayati | bhavanto mā bibhīta | ihāhaṃ tiṣṭhāmi | śayyāṃ pratyavaikṣanta |apanītā śayyā |kena | viśākhayā |paṇḍitā cāṇpeyikā |
sākṣipṛṣṭamānam (sākṣipṛṣṭasmān)
saṃbodho bādhyate tridhā |
tāny ucyante, bhadanta śāradvatīputra, bodhisattvānāṃ catvāry akṣayāṇi samyakprahāṇāni.
sa tu vikṣīṇasamyogaḥ kṣīṇamāno niraupadhiḥ | kāyasya bhedat saprajñaḥ saṃkhyān nopaiti nirvṛtaḥ
kṛtacaṅkramaṇaḥ (kṛtacaṅkramaṇam)
bhave bahuprapātaś ca tatra cāsattvam īdṛśam | tatrānyonyavirodhaś ca na bhavet tattvam īdṛśam
śirīṣapakṣmāgralaghu sthairyaṃ bhavati pārthivam | akampye sarvadharmāṇāṃ tvatsthairye ’bhimukhīkṛte
tayā yathāvṛttam ārocitam | sā saṃlakṣayati | yady ahaṃ prasūtā bhaveyam aham apy evaṃvidhaṃ duḥkham anubhaveyam |
naiva svataḥ prasidhir na parasparataḥ parapramāṇair vā | na bhavati na ca prameyair na cāpyakasmāt pramāṇānāṃ
tatra tāvat | dvayaṃ pratītya vijñānasaṃbhavāt pratyayo na saḥ |
śrīsaṃbhavavimokṣāc ca śikṣed yad guruvartanam | etac cānyac ca buddhoktaṃ jñeyaṃ sūtrāntavācanāt

sa vai vitarkopaśamena cetasā spṛśeta sambodhi sukhaṃ hy anuttaram | śubhaṃ samādhiṃ manasā nibandhayed vivekajaṃ bhāvayitvāpramāṇam | pradālayitvā tribhir ālayāṃs trīn jahāti bandhān nipakaḥ pratismṛtaḥ
uttiṣṭhata vyāyamata dṛḍhaṃ śikṣata śāntaye | asmṛtiś ca pramādaś caivānutthānam asamyamaḥ
te ’pi lokasya guravo yeṣām asy aguro guruḥ | ato gurūṇām api te gu(ra)ve gu(ra)ve namaḥ
yat karoti naraḥ karma kalyāṇam atha pāpakam | tasya tasyaiva dāyādo na hi karma praṇaśyati
nāyam anaśanena jīvate nāhāro hṛdayasya śāntaye | āhāraḥ sthitaye tu vidyate taj jñātvā hi careta eṣaṇām
yatas tato vāstu bhayaṃ yady ahaṃ nāma kiṃcana | aham eva na kiṃcic ced bhayaṃ kasya bhaviṣyati
yadi devo ’nujānīte vayaṃ tān karapratyāyān samucchindāmaḥ |
anyatrāśravaṇād asya saddharmasyāvijānakāḥ | āyuṣy evaṃ paritte hi vairaṃ kurvanti kenacit
cetanācetane caikyaṃ tayor yenāstitā samā | viśeṣaś ca yadā mithyā kaḥ sādṛśyāśrayas tadā
yaḥ punar bhikṣur ajñātikāyai bhikṣuṇyai cīvaraṃ dadyād anyatra parivartakāt pāyantikā |
kāyakalisampramathano nāma samādhiḥ
upāye bodhisatvānām asamaṃ sarvabhūmiṣu | yatkauśalyaṃ samāśritya sarvārthān sādhayanti te
kaiścit samutpatya nabho vimuktāḥ śilāś ca vṛkṣāś ca paraśvadhāś ca | tasthur nabhasy eva na cāvapetuḥ saṃdhyābhrapādā iva naikavarṇāḥ

ebhiś caturbhir prajñālokair bodhisattvānāṃ jñānasaṃbhāra upacīyate, katamaiś caturbhis?tad yathocchedāvihāritā;śāśvatāpraveśatā;pratītyasamutpādāvirodhatā;nairātmyakṣāntiḥ.taiś caturbhiḥ prajñālokair bodhisattvānāṃ jñānasaṃbhāra upacīyate.
bhājayata yūyaṃ bhikṣava upanandasya bhikṣor mṛtapariṣkāram iti |
sthūlabhittikatā audārikatā
yathā māyākṛtyasyābhāve tasya nimittasya kāṣṭhādikasya vyaktir bhūtārthopalabhyate tathāśrayaparāvṛttau dvayabhrāntyabhāvād abhūtaparikalpasya bhūto ’rtha upalabhyate |
vitarkavicārayoḥ kiṃ nānākāraṇam |
bahavo lābhino ’bhūvan bahavaś ca yaśasvinaḥ | saha lābhayaśobhis te na jñātāḥ kva gatā iti
nāsti cec chāśvataḥ kaścit ko bhaviṣyaty aśāśvataḥ | śāśvato ’śāśvataś cāpi dvābhyām ābhyāṃ tiraskṛtaḥ
hyastanike na parijñātam |
pratibimbam asiddhatvād asāmyāc cānidarśanam
gantavyaṃ bhikṣuṇā tad eva poṣadhe pañcadaśyāṃ sabhikṣukād āvāsāt sabhikṣukam āvāsaṃ anāvāsaṃ yatra bhikṣavo bhavanti pariśuddhāḥ samānadṛṣṭayaḥ |
bhujiṣyatā bodhisukhaṃ tvadguṇāpacitiḥ śamaḥ | prāpyate tvanmatāt sarvam idaṃ bhadracatuṣṭayam
na hastituṇḍāvalambitam
mahato janakāyasya
tata upanandena trayo bhāgāḥ kṛtāḥ | dvayor bhāgayor madhye svayaṃ niṣaṇṇaḥ | tayor dvayor madhye ekaṃ bhāgaṃ sthāpayitvā jñaptiṃ kartum ārabdhaḥ |
iti yānatrayakauśalāt jñānaṃ |
tato jīvakenāmalakaṃ dadatā pācanīyāni dravyāṇi dattāni | paṃca ca ghaṭaśatāni pācanīyair dravyair bhāvitāni |
śāntaṃ na śāntyā śāntaṃ bhavati, śāntam eva śāntam,nāpy aśāntaṃ śāntyā śāntaṃ bhavati.yac chāntārthaṃ sā sarvanimittopaśāntir,idaṃ śāntam iti;śāntaṃ nirvāṇam.

āyuṣmān upālī buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ pṛcchati |pāriśuddhigrāhakas tāvad bhadanta bhikṣuḥ pāriśuddhiṃ gṛhītvā tatraivocchidya kālaṃ kuryād ānītā pāriśuddhir vaktavyā | anānītā |anānītā upāliṃ punar apy ānayitavyā |
draṣṭānya eva śrotānyo vedako ’nyaḥ punar yadi | sati syād draṣṭari śrotā bahutvaṃ cātmanāṃ bhavet

ity eṣa mūlaskandhaśākhāpatrapuṣpaphalāvasthaḥ karuṇāvṛkṣo veditavyaḥ | etasya karuṇā mūlaṃ | kṣāntiḥ skandhaḥ | satvārthacintā śākhā | praṇidhānaṃ śobhaneṣu janmasu patrāṇi | śobhanaṃ janma puṣpaṃ | satvaparipākaḥ phalaṃ |
tatra dvābhyām atha dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ yathākramam | padābhyāṃ nityatādyartho vijñeyo ’saṃskṛte pade
yathā pāṃśuviśeṣeṇa vastre raṅgavicitratā kvacid avicitratā | tathaiva pūrvaprāṇidhānacaryābalādhānaviśeṣāt buddhānāṃ vimuktau jñānavicitratā bhavati | śrāvakapratyekabuddhānāṃ vimuktāv avicitratā |
etadd hi dṛṣṭvā śikṣeta sadā śīleṣu paṇḍitaḥ | nirvāṇagamanaṃ mārgaṃ kṣipram eva viśodhayet
anupalipto rūpaiḥ
tato vihīnaṃ kapilāhvayaṃ puraṃ mahātmanā tena jagaddhitātmanā | krameṇa tau śūnyam ivopajagmatur divākareṇeva vinākṛtaṃ nabhaḥ
akṣayamatir āha: yāvanto rūpāvabhāsāḥ, kulaputrāsmiṃs trisāhasramahāsāhasralokadhātau, te sarve matkāye praviṣṭo ’pi matkāyadharmatāyāṃ na syād upacayo vāpacayo vā.
parimaṇḍalaṃ nivāsanaṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
te ’pi kathayanti | tvam evāpanayeti |
bhagavataḥ śrāvakasya |
susukhaṃ bata jīvāmo vairikeṣu tv avairikāḥ | vairikeṣu manuṣyeṣu viharāmo hy avairikāḥ
nikṣipte pade avanamati
saṃskāreṣv ātmā

aśuddho ’śuddhaśuddho ’tha suviśuddho yathākramam | sattvadhātur iti prokto bodhisattvas tathāgataḥ anena kiṃ darśitam | svabhāvādibhir ity ebhiḥ ṣaḍbhir arthaiḥ samāsataḥ | dhātus tisṛṣv avasthāsu vidito nāmabhis tribhiḥ
tasmāt svaduḥkhaśāntyarthaṃ paraduḥkhaśamāya ca | dadāmy anyebhya ātmānaṃ parān gṛhṇāmi cātmavat
śunyāgāraṃ praviṣṭasya prahitātmasya bhikṣuṇaḥ | amānuṣā ratir bhavati samyag dharmān vipaśyataḥ
yayātiś caiva rājarṣir vayasy api vinirgate | viśvācyāpsarasā sārdhaṃ reme caitrarathe vane
mātāpitarau raktau bhavataḥ saṃnipatitau ' mātā kalyā bhavati ṛtumatī gandharvaś ca pratyupasthito bhavati | eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ sthānānāṃ saṃmukhībhāvāt putrā jāyante duhitaraś ca |
andhabhūto hy ayaṃ lokas tanuko ’tra vipaśyataḥ | śakunto jālamukta iva hy alpaṃ svargeṣu modate
adhimukter vicārāc ca yathāvat parataḥ śravāt | nirjalpād api ca jñānād apraṇāśo hi dhīmatāṃ
tam enam aham etad avocam:ahaṃ mārṣa imaṃ triṃsāhasramahāsāhasraṃ lokadhātuṃ bhagavataḥ śākyamuner buddhakṣetraṃ tad yathāpi nāma karatale nyastam āmalakaphalam evaṃ paśyāmi |
te kathayanti | amba eṣa mallo mallena nihataḥ kālagato nīyate |putra jīvako ’tra vaidyarāja āgataḥ | sthānam etad vidyate yad enaṃ svasthīkariṣyati |
kleśābhyāsaḥ kumitratvaṃ vidhātaḥ paratantratā | gotrasyādīnavo jñeyaḥ samāsena caturvidhaḥ
tatra sattvārambaṇā maitrī prathamacittotpādikānāṃ bodhisattvānām;
te dvārakoṣṭhake yogaṃ vāhayanti | pracālayanti ca | aśrāddhā avasphaṇḍayanti | etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti |bhagavān āha | na dvārakoṣṭhake yogo vāhayitavyaḥ |
śithilākulamūrdhajā tathānyā jaghanasrastavibhūṣaṇāṃśukāntā | aśayiṣṭavikīrṇakaṇṭhasūtrā gajabhagnā pratiyātanāṅganeva
viśvāsaṃ janayaty ekaṃ satyaṃ rājñāṃ yathā dṛḍham | tathaivānṛtam apy eṣām aviśvāsakaraṃ param
darśanaśravaṇādīni vedanādīni cāpy atha | na vidyate ced yasya sa na vidyanta imāny api
sāṃparāyikāṇāṃ setusamudghātāya (saṃparāyikāṇāṃ setusamudgatāya)
ghanagrāho gṛhītas tu yenāstīti tathāgataḥ | nāstīti sa vikalpayan nirvṛtasyāpi kalpayet
mahābhūtāny upādāyety uktāni katamāni bhūtāni |
prahāṇato na praheyo bhāvanāheya eva vā | tasmād avipraṇāśena jāyate karmaṇāṃ phalam
tatra katamā pravṛttiḥ? yā sarvāstiparityāgatā. tatra katamā sthitiḥ? yā dānāmanyanā.
bhavanti hy arthadāyādāḥ puruṣasya viparyaye | pṛthivyāṃ dharmadāyādāḥ durlabhās tu na santi vā
imaṃ ye kāyam icchanti te ’pi me suhṛdaḥ kila | sarve svakāyam icchanti te ’pi kasmān na me priyāḥ

tṛtīyād dhyānād anyatra kāmadhātau prathame dvitīye ca dhyāne sā caiatasikī śātā vedanā saumanasyendriyam |tṛtīye tu dhyāne prītivītarāgatvāt sukhendriyam eva sā na saumanasyendriyam |prītir hi saumanasyam |
yasya dharmaṃ vijānīyād vṛddhasya daharasya vā | satkṛtyainaṃ paricared agni hotram iva dvijaḥ
ime duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ prāṇino yānti durgatim | ime ’nye śubhakarmāṇaḥ pratiṣṭhante tripiṣṭape
na cuccatkārakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
atārṣīccakṣuḥ samudram
saṃketadharmatālabdhaṃ saṃvarastheṣu vidyate | śīlam evaṃ parijñāya paṇḍitaḥ samudānayet
asaṃskṛtaṃ hi sāratvād dravyam | tac ca dharmadhātāv asty ato dharmadhātur eko dravyayuktaḥ |
divyo yady ekadeśaḥ syād ekadeśaś ca mānuṣaḥ | aśāśvataṃ śāśvataṃ ca bhavet tac ca na yujyate
namastāre ture vīre kṣaṇadyutinibhekṣaṇe | trailokyanāthavaktrābja vikasatkamalodbhave
śreyo hi labhate nityaṃ yaḥ śreṣṭhān upasevate | prajñayā cottamatamān śīlenopaśamena ca
yadā māyaiva te nāsti tadā kim upalabhyate | cittasyaiva sa ākāro yady apy anyo ’sti tattvataḥ
evaṃ nākaraṇīyān dharmān karoti; iyam ucyata upekṣā, tatra tatra na vyāyacchate.
etān āśritya me pāpaṃ kṣīyate kṣamato bahu | mām āśritya tu yānty ete narakān dīrghavedanān
madhyamapadalopam kṛtvā
ye dharmās taddhātvāptās teṣāṃ svadhātukā prāptiḥ |kāmarūpārūpyāvacarāṇāṃ kāmarūpārūpyāvacarī yathākramam |
karmajñānobhayeṣāṃ vā viśadatvād yathākramam
dvitīyāyāṃ vāci bhāṣitāyāṃ paryavasitāyāṃ pravāraṇāṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ pravāraṇāsthāpanam.
udānam (uddānam)

diśaś catasraś codvīkṣya vācaṃ pravyāhariṣyati | iyaṃ me paścimā jātir nāsti bhūyaḥ punarbhavaḥ | na punar abhyāgamiṣyāmi nirvāsyāmi nirāsravaḥ saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ sattvānāṃ duḥkhabhāginām | tṛṣṇābandhanabaddhānāṃ kariṣyāmi vimocanam
na caiṣa dharmo vanae eva siddhaḥ pure ’pi siddhir niyatā yatīnām | buddhiś ca yatnaś ca nimittam atra vanaṃ ca liṅgaṃ ca hi bhīrucihnam
prāgjātaḥ sahajātaś ca hetur āhetuko ’rthataḥ | prajñapter apratītatvād utpatteś caiva tattvataḥ
na niṣaṇṇā nipannāyāglānāya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāmaḥ

kiṃ manyadhve bhikṣavaḥ |yā sā vṛddhā yuvatir eṣaiva sā viśākhā |tena kālena tena samayena ye te dvātriṃśad goṣṭhikā eta eva te dvātriṃśad viśākhāputrāḥ |yad anayā tatra praṇidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya karmaṇo vipākena dvātriṃśadaṇḍāni prasūtāni |
svargāya yuṣmākam ayaṃ tu dharmo mamābhilāṣas tv apunarbhavāya | asmin vane yena na me vivatsā bhinnaḥ pravṛttyā hi nivṛttidharmaḥ
eka utpadyate jantur mriyate caika eva hi | nānyasya tadvyathābhāgaḥ kiṃ priyair vighnakārakaiḥ
bhagavān āha | āgārikā hy enaṃ dhārayanti | tasmān na bhikṣuṇā sarvanīlaṃ cīvaraṃ dhārayitavyam | pūrvavad yāvat sātisāro bhavati |evaṃ sarvapītaṃ sarvalohitam avadātaṃ na kalpayaty eva |
yady amībhya ime ’nye syur ebhyo vāmī pare yadi | bhavet parakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ parair ebhir amī kṛtāḥ

yad idam duḥkhajñānaṃ samudayajñānaṃ nirodhajñānaṃ mārgajñānam.tatra duḥkhajñānam iti yat skandheṣv anutpādajñānam,samudayajñānam iti yat tṛṣṇāyāṃ sunihatajñānam,nirodhajñānam ity avidyānuśayāpravṛttiḥ,mārgajñānam iti sarveṣu samatābhūteṣu dharmeṣv asamāropaḥ,tad bodhisattvasya satyajñānam.
kasya cid dhi bhavantīme kleśāḥ sa ca na sidhyati | kaścid āho vinā kaṃcit santi kleśā na kasyacit
caturdhā vaśitā vṛtter manasaś codgrahaś ca ca | vikalpasyāvikalpe hi kṣetre jñāne ’tha karmaṇi
āptayo dvidhā |
paribhāvitātmāna jinendraputrān kāṃścic ca paśyāmy ahu tatra tatra | dharmaṃ vadanto bahuprāṇakoṭināṃ dṛṣṭāntahetūnayutair anekaiḥ

yat kathayati na kasyacid utthāyāsanaṃ dātavyam iti |evaṃ kathayati | tvaṃ kulavadhū tvayā pratigupte sthāne niṣettavyam |sāhaṃ pratigupta eva niṣīdāmi |
sa bhagavān āha:tathā mahātmā sa bodhisatvo yat sarvabuddhakṣetreṣu nirmitān preṣayati |te ca nirmitā buddhakṛtyena satvānāṃ pratyupasthitā bhavanti |
ātmā tv ihātmano nāthaḥ ko nu nāthaḥ paro bhavet | ātmanā hi sudāntena dharmaṃ labhati paṇḍitaḥ
sa tvaṃ doṣān ātmanīyān asmāsu paripātayan | aśvam evābhirūḍhaḥ sann aśvam evāsi vismṛtaḥ

dharmadhātuḥ pṛthivīdhātur api na tu dharmadhātuḥ kaṭhinalakṣaṇaḥ;dharmadhātur abdhātur api na tu dharmadhātuḥ snehalakṣaṇaḥ;dharmadhātus tejodhātur api na tu dharmadhātuḥ paripācanalakṣaṇaḥ;dharmadhātur vāyudhātur api na tu dharmadhātuḥ samudīraṇalakṣaṇaḥ.
tena naimittikā āhūya pṛṣṭāḥ | te kathayanti | deva pratipālyatām | saptame divase sphuṭiṣyati | tanmadhyād dārikā bhaviṣyati |
caramāṇu yo na iha kalpayi buddhadharmāṃ bala ṛddhipāda na ca kalpayi bodhi śāntām | avikalpakalpavigato ’dhiṣṭhānacārī eṣā sa prajñavarapāramitāya caryā
evamādīni duḥkhāni karotīty ari saṃjñayā | yaḥ krodhaṃ hanti nirbandhāt sa sukhīha paratra ca
saṃbhinnapralāpāt prativiratiḥ
pratiṣedhapratiṣedho ’py evam iti mataṃ bhavet tad asad eva | evam tava pratijñā lakṣaṇato dūṣyate na mama
siṃho yathaiva girikandari niśrayitvā nadate achambhi mṛga kṣudraka trāsayanto | tatha prajñapāramitaniśraya narāṇa siṃho nadate achambhi pṛthutīrthika trāsayanto
vṛddhiṃ hāniṃ ca kāṅkṣanti satvānāṃ ca prapācanaṃ | viśeṣagamanaṃ bhūmau bodhiṃ cānuttarāṃ sadā
āha: kathaṃ prayuktaḥ punar yoniśaḥ prayukto bhavati |
sarvajña iti sarvajño budhais tenaiva gamyate | yenaitad dharmagāmbhīryaṃ novācābhājane jane
ātmanā hi kṛte pāpe tv ātmanā kliśyate sadā | ātmanā tv akṛte pāpe hy ātmanaiva viśudhyate
adya me saphalaṃ janma sulabdho mānuṣo bhavaḥ | adya buddhakule jāto buddhaputro ’smi sāmpratam
subhūtir āha āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvat sūkṣmeṇopāyena rūpataś ca nivārito nirvāṇaṃ ca sucitam |evaṃ vedanā saṃjñā saṃskārāḥ |yāvat sūkṣmeṇopāyena vijñānataś ca nivārito nirvāṇaṃ ca sūcitam |
alpam api cet sahitaṃ bhāṣamāṇo dharmasya bhavati hy anudharmacārī | rāgaṃ ca doṣaṃ ca tathaiva mohaṃ prahāyabhāgī śrāmaṇyārthasya bhavati
sadodgṛhītadharmāvismaraṇaprajñopāyaniṣṭhāgatasattvanistāraṇaprasādasaṃ darśanaśubhānantarāyikavaiśāradyam
rūpe saty eva rūpasya kāraṇaṃ nopapadyate | rūpe ’saty eva rūpasya kāraṇaṃ nopapadyate
śrīmadvitāne kanakojjvalāṅge vaiḍūryapāde śayane śayānam | yadgauravāt kāñcanapadmahastā yakṣādhipāḥ saṃparivārya tasthuḥ
bhāvanāmayaṃ puṇyakriyāvastu
yaḥ punar bhikṣur asaṃmataḥ saṃghena bhikṣuṇīr avavadet tadrūpadharmasamanvāgamāt pāyantikā |
aprameyaprabhāvasya sā buddhāveṇikasya te | deśanāprātihāryasya vyuṣṭir vyuṣṭimatāṃ vara

śroṇa yadi na śraddadhāsyati vaktavyaḥ tava pitrāgniṣṭomasyādhastāt suvarṇakalaśaḥ pūrayitvā sthāpitaḥ | tam uddhṛtyātmānaṃ samyaksukhena prīṇaya āryaṃ ca mahākātyāyanaṃ kālena kālaṃ piṇḍakena pratipādaya asmākaṃ ca nāmnā dakṣiṇām ādeśaya | apy evaitat karma tanutvaṃ parikṣayaṃ paryādānaṃ gacchet |
anantavān lokaḥ
upapadya parinirvāyī
gṛdhrair āmiṣasaṃgṛddhaiḥ kṛṣyamāṇa itastataḥ | na karoty anyathā kāyaḥ kasmād atra pratikriyām
daśa bhāvanayā heyāḥ pañca ca
yaś ca pradīptāc charaṇāt kathaṃcin niṣkramya bhūyaḥ praviśet tad eva | gārhasthyam utsṛjya sa dṛṣṭadoṣo mohena bhūyo ’bhilaṣed grahītum
upadravebhyaḥ sarvebhyo apāyād anupāyataḥ | satkāyād dhīnayānāc ca tasmāc charaṇam uttamam
himavān parvatarājo himasaṃyogān nityaṃ śītalo bhagavataḥ sābhiṣyandaṃ glānam utpannam | jīvako vaidyarājaḥ saṃlakṣayati | svayam evāhaṃ bhagavata upasthānaṃ karomi tadyathā rājñaś cakravartina iti |
mamety aham iti kṣīṇe bahirdhādhyātmam eva ca | nirudhyata upādānaṃ tatkṣayāj janmanaḥ kṣayaḥ
jñātīnāṃ vā vinā bhāvaṃ bhogānāṃ vā parikṣayam | rājato hy upasargaṃ vāpy abhyākhyānaṃ ca dāruṇam
puṇyaṃ devāḥ praśaṃsanti samacaryāṃ ca yaś caret | iha cānindito bhavati pretyasvarge ca modate
krodhād durvarṇatā maurkhyam apraśnena vipaścitām | phalam etan manuṣyatve sarvebhyaḥ prāk tu durgatiḥ
paśya citrakṛtaṃ bimbam arukaṃ kāyasaṃjñitam | āturaṃ moṣasaṃkalpaṃ yasya nāsti dhruvasthitiḥ
yo hy asmin dharmavinaye tv apramatto bhaviṣyati | prahāya jāti saṃsāraṃ duhkhasyāntaṃ sa yāsyati
punar aparaṃ trividhaṃ bodhisattvasya satyam.
aho prabhāvaḥ puruṣarṣabhasya aho ’sya jñānaṃ vipulaṃ anāsravam | yasyaikaraśmiḥ prasṛtādya loke darśeti kṣetrāṇa bahū sahasrān
kṛṣṇān dharmān viprahāya śuklān bhāvayata bhikṣavaḥ | okād anokaṃ āgamyavivekam anubṛṃhayet | tatra cābhirametāryo hitvā kāmān akiṃcanaḥ
anādikālaprahatā bahvyaḥ prakṛtayo nṛṇām | tvayā vibhāvitāpāyāḥ kṣaṇena parivartitāḥ
muhūrtam api saprajñaḥ paṇḍitān paryupāsate | sa vai dharmaṃ vijānāti prajñā tasya hi vidyate
na saṃsārasya nirvāṇāt kiṃcid asti viśeṣaṇam | na nirvāṇasya saṃsārāt kiṃcid asti viśeṣaṇam
avaśaṃsyati (avamaṃsyati)
sa kathayati | mamaiva tena yathāsukhaṃ kṛtam iti | etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti | bhagavān āha |
catuṣpraveśaṃ bodhisattvasya satyakauśalyam.katame catvāraḥ praveśāḥ?
tatra me vimalakīrtir licchavir upasaṃkramya mām evam āha
avyākṛtāptiḥ sahajā
godantaḥ (goṇadantaḥ)
tato jīvakena dvātriṃśad utpalāni sraṃsanīyair dravyair bhāvayitvā bhagavate dattāni |jighratu bhagavān etānīti |
ācīrṇadaṇḍatā (acīrṇadaṇḍatā)
vṛkṣeṇa vṛkṣābhyām vṛkṣaiḥ
sarvālpair niḥśubho ’ṣṭābhir vinmanaḥkāyajīvitaiḥ | yuktaḥ
sutatvabodhaiḥ sumahārthabodhaiḥ sarvāvarthabodhair api nityabodhaiḥ | upāyabodhaiś ca viśeṣaṇena tenocyate hetuna bodhisatvaḥ
tatra kenārthena kim adhikṛtya bhagavatā śaraṇatrayaṃ prajñaptam |
āha: apravyāhārā hi devate vimuktiḥ | tan na jāne kiṃ vyāharāmīti |
yatra cchanne ’py ayaṃ rāgas tad acchannaṃ kim apriyam | na cet prayojanaṃ tena kasmāc channaṃ vimṛdyate
mukhapūraṃ na bhuñjīta saśabdaṃ prasṛtānanam | pralambapādaṃ nāsīta na bāhū mardayet samam
tato dvau trīn vā divasān āsamudācārikān dharmāṃ śikṣayitvābhihito bhadramukha na mṛgo mṛgaṃ puṣṇāti vistīrṇā śrāvastī svo gocaraḥ pitryo viṣayaḥ piṇḍapātam aṭitvā jīvikāṃ kalpayasveti |
vigate divase tato vimānaṃ vapuṣā sūrya iva pradīpyamānaḥ | timiraṃ vijighāṃsur ātmabhāsā ravir udyann iva merum āruroha

asyām akṣayāyāṃ vīryapāramitāyāṃ nirdiśyamāṇāyāṃ ṣaṭsaptatīnāṃ devamānuṣikaprajānayutānām anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau cittāny utpāditāni, dvātriṃśatīnāṃ ca bodhisattvasahasrāṇām anutpattikadharmakṣāntiḥ pratilabdhā.
sarvatṛṣṇāṃ viprahāya sarvasamyojanakṣayāt | sarvopadhiṃ parijñāya nāgacchanti punar bhavam
yaḥ pañcaskandhānāṃ tṛṣṇāhetudṛṣtihetvanuśayo ’yaṃ samudaya iti.yas tau tṛṣṇāhetudṛṣṭihetū nopādatte na samāropayati na spṛśatīdaṃ samudaye samudayajñānam āryasatyam.
sa kathayati | na jāne |
garbhayātanam (garbhavātanam)
upapattivayovarṇadeśakālaniratyayam | tvayā hi bhagavan dharmasarvātithyam idam kṛtam
gāḍhagaṃbhīrabhāvāc ca parasūtraviśiṣṭataḥ | mahāśuddhānvayatvāc ca puṇyāt puṇyaṃ viśiṣyate ||
mahatyāḥ sīmāyāś caturdiśaṃ sthāvarāṇi nimittāni parikīrtayitavyāni | pūrvavad yāvat prāgbhāranimittaṃ vā |
sa vismayanivṛttyarthaṃ tapaḥpūjārtham eva ca | svāṃ cānuvartitāṃ rakṣaṇn aśvapṛṣṭhād avātarat
tūlagarbhair mṛdusparśai ramante nopadhānakaiḥ | durgandhaṃ na sravantīti kāmino ’medhyamohitāḥ
ity ācāryacandrakīrtipādoparacitāyāṃ prasannapadāyāṃ madhyamakavṛttau pratyayaparīkṣā nāma prathamaṃ prakaraṇam ||
adhyavasānam āpannaḥ
lobhavyāpādanāstikyadṛṣṭīnāṃ parivarjanam | ete karmapathāḥ śuklā daśa kṛṣṇā viparyayāt
āha: dvāṣaṣṭiḥ punar dṛṣṭigatāni kuto mārgitavyāni |
vividhakuśalābhinirhāranimittaṃ sadā sarvatra ratyā viharaṇād bodhisatvānāṃ bhūmayo vihārā ity ucyante |
itīṣṭāniṣṭasevāyā(ṃ) tavānekāṃśavādina(ḥ | (pada)vīm anuyāsyanti katham ekāṃśavādinaḥ
āha: nanu bhadanta śāriputra nirmitasvabhāvāḥ sarvadharmās tathāgatena nirdiṣṭāḥ |
anye catvāraḥ śeṣā rūparasagandhaspraṣṭavyadhātavaḥ |te vipākajā apy aupacayikā api naiḥṣyandrikā api |
āha: itas tvaṃ devate cyutā kutropapatsyase |
ahaṃ kārasṛtā martyāḥ parakāropasaṃhitāḥ | etad eke na jānanti paśyanti na hi śalyataḥ
yad asya dharmaparyāyasya prapāthadeśanāprayogabhāvanākāyavākcittavīryam asau tasya vīryapāramitā.
kāme daśa navāṣṭau vā
sa tayā sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati yāvad āmrapālī āpannasatvā saṃvṛttā |tadā bimbisārāya niveditam | deva āpannasatvāsmi saṃvṛtteti |

kliṣṭā dharmā vipākahetuṃ hitvā śeṣebhyaḥ pañcabhyo jāyante |vipākajā sarvatragahetuṃ hetvā śeṣebhyaḥ pañcabhya eva |śeṣā dharmāstau vipākasarvatragahetū hitvā śeṣebhyaś caturbhryo jāyante |prathamānāsravās tau ca vipākasarvatragahetū sabhāgahetuṃ ca hitvā śeṣebhyaḥ tribhyo jāyante |
dānaṃ śīlaṃ ca puṇyasya prajñā jñānasya saṃbhṛtiḥ | trayaṃ cānyad dvayasyāpi pañcāpi jñānasaṃbhṛtiḥ
gurusālohitādīnāṃ priyāṇāṃ cāpakāriṣu | pūrvavat pratyayotpādaṃ dṛṣṭvā kopaṃ nivārayet
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ | nairarthakyāt | na hi tatra kiṃcit sāmarthyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ |
itīma ekaṃ dhārmikaṃ pravāraṇāsthāpanam ekam adhārmikaṃ |
idaṃ purā cittam acāri cārikāṃ yenecchakaṃ yena kāmaṃ yatheṣṭam | tat samnigṛhṇāmi hi yoniśas tv idaṃ nāgaṃ prabhinnaṃ hi yathāṅkuśena
jīvakaḥ saṃlakṣayati | upādhyāyasyaivopadeśena cikitsām asya karomīti |
yadi cātmadarśanena mokṣa ity asau deśyeta | evaṃ sati syāt
jihvendriyaṃ nirnāmayām āsa
māyeti vañcanā śāṭhyaṃ cittasaṃtānajihmatā | īrṣyā paraguṇais tāpo mātsaryaṃ tyāgabhīrutā
duḥkham apy āyatīpathyaṃ kāryaṃ kim u sukhaṃ hitam | ātmanaś ca pareṣāṃ ca dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ
ātmā tv ihātmano nāthaḥ ko nu nāthaḥ paro bhavet | ātmanā hi sudāntena svargaṃ labhati paṇḍitaḥ

asminn akṣayadharmamukhaparivarte ’kṣayamatinā bodhisattvena nirdiśyamāne ’ṣṭāsaptatyāḥ prāṇaśatasahasrāṇām anuttarāyāṃ samyaksaṃbodhau cittāny utpāditāni, dvāpañcaśataś ca bodhisattvasahasrāṇām anutpattikadharmakṣāntiḥ pratilabdhā.
cāre vihāre sarvatra nāsty asarvajñaceṣṭitaṃ | sarvadā tava sarvajña bhūtārthika namo ’stu te
nikāyaṃ jīvitaṃ cātra niśritā cittasantatiḥ
saṃskṛtā mārgavarjitāḥ | sāsravāḥ
ūrdhvaṃ saptadaśasthāno rūpadhātuḥ
niṣpannabodhāt padabodhataś ca garbhānubodhāt kramadarśanasya | bodhād bhṛśaṃ saṃśayahānibodhāt tenocyate hetuna bodhisatvaḥ

yadi ca manyase ’napekṣyaiva pramāṇāni prameyāṇāṃ prasiddhir bhavatīti kiṃ idānīṃ te pramāṇasiddhyā paryanviṣṭayā | kiṃ kāraṇam |yad arthaṃ hi tāni pramāṇāni paryanviṣyeran te prameyārthā vināpi pramāṇaiḥ siddhāḥ | tatra kiṃ pramāṇaiḥ kṛtyaṃ |
apramādarato bhikṣuḥ pramāde bhayadarśakaḥ | dhunāti pāpakāṃ dharmāṃ pattrāṇīva hi mārutaḥ
guṇeṣu guṇavatsu cāgauravatā apratīśatā abhayam avaśavartitā āhrīkyaṃ gauravapratidvandvo dharmaḥ ||
cirād apāyagamanam āśumokṣaś ca tatra ca | tanuduḥkhopasaṃvittiḥ sodvegā satvapācanā
ciraṃ dhakṣyati me kāyaṃ nārakāgniḥ suduḥsahaḥ | paścāttāpānalaś cittaṃ ciraṃ dhakṣyaty aniścitam
yathā śākaṭiko mārgaṃ samaṃ hitvā mahāpatham | viṣamaṃ mārgaṃ āgamya chinnākṣaḥ śocate bhṛśam
snigdhābhir ābhir hṛdayaṃ gamābhiḥ samāsataḥ snāta ivāsmi vāgbhiḥ | ratiś ca me dharmanavagrahasya vispanditā saṃprati bhūya eva
parair asādhāraṇayogakevalaṃ tridhātukakleśavihānipūrakam | svabhāvaśuddhaṃ malaśuddhitaś ca tac caturguṇabrahmavicaryam iṣyate
niruktiniyatapraveśo nāma samādhiḥ
rātriṃdivam aviśrāmam āyuṣo vardhate vyayaḥ | āyasya cāgamo nāsti na mariṣyāmi kiṃ nv aham
duḥkham evābhidhāvanti duḥkhaniḥsaraṇāśayā | sukhecchayaiva saṃmohāt svasukhaṃ ghnanti śatruvat
ye ’nayor na vijānanti vibhāgaṃ satyayor dvayoḥ | te tattvaṃ na vijānanti gambhīraṃ buddhaśāsane
prāyeṇānarthatityakṣur arthaṃ tyajati bāliśaḥ | arthārthī cāparijñānād anarthaṃ pratipadyate
“nāmasaṃniśāritā gāthā gāthānāṃ kavirāśrayaḥ” iti
yo bodhisattva cirasaṃsaraṇābhiprāyo sattvārtha kṣetrapariśodhanayuktayogī | na ca khedabuddhi aṇumātra upādiyāti so vīryapāramitayukta atandritaś ca
priyeṇa vaśyena hitena sādhunā tvayā sahāyena yathārthakāriṇā | gato ’ryaputro hy apunarnivṛttaye ramasva diṣṭyā saphalaḥ śramas tava
jñānadarśanaśuddhyā buddhajñānād anuttarāt | avaivartyād bhavanty āryāḥ śaraṇaṃ sarvadehinām
kathaṃcid api saṃprāpto hitabhūmiṃ sudurlabhām | jānann api ca nīye ’haṃ tān eva narakān punaḥ
iti ratnagotravibhāge mahāyānottaratantraśāstre tathāgatakṛtyakriyādhikāraś caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ ślokārthasaṃgrahavyākhyānataḥ samāptaḥ
anutpannāḥ kathaṃ nāma bhaviṣyanti viparyayāḥ | viparyayeṣv ajāteṣu viparyayagataḥ kutaḥ

punas tasyaivaṃ bhavati:atigambhīraḥ pratītyasamutpādo hetuphalāvipraṇāśatayākiṃ cāpi cittadharmataivaṃ bhavet sarvadharmā hetupratyayādhīnā nirīhā niśceṣṭā asvāmikā aparigrahāḥ.tān yathecchaṃ viṭhapayeyam, viṭhapanāyāṃ mayā yogaḥ karaṇīyaḥ, iyaṃ ca cittadharmatā na vihātavyā.
vetti sarvajña evaitām acintyāṃ karmaṇo gatim | yad bodhicittatyāge ’pi mocayaty eva tāṃ narān
neśvarādeḥ kramādibhiḥ
āryāṣṭasāhasrikāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ stutiparivarto nāma navamaḥ ||
kiṃ cānyat | aprāpto ’pi jvalano yadi vā punar andhakāram upahanyāt | sarveṣu lokadhātuṣu tamo ’yam iha saṃsthito hānyat
ātmaparīkṣā nāmāṣṭadaśamaṃ prakaraṇaṃ ||
tato ’sau gṛhapatir avadhyāyitum ārabdhaḥ | etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti |
āryasatyāni catvāri prajñayā paśyate yadā | eṣa mārgaṃ prajānāti bhavatṛṣṇā pradālanam
atṛptā vateme sattvā lābhasatkāraślokopacaritās tṛptāḥ sma iti pratijānante
te sarvasaṃghaṃ sannipātayanti | bhikṣūṇāṃ kuśalapakṣaparihāṇir bhavati | etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti |bhagavān āha | khuḍḍalikā sīmā baddhavyā | saṃmantavyo maṇḍalaka |
atha kasmād vaṇijo muṣitāḥ
asty ekavācikā pravāraṇā, dvivācikā pravāraṇā, trivācikā pravāraṇā, gaṇapravāraṇā. kasminn arthe ekavācikā pravāraṇā.
bhūmiviṣṭasya bodhyaṅgavyavasthānaṃ vidhīyate | dharmāṇāṃ sarvasatvānāṃ samatāvagamāt punaḥ
anihśritasyācalitaṃ prasrabdhiś ceha vidyate | na gatir na cyutiś caiva duhkhasyānto nirucyate
vīryeṇa śuklaguṇa hāni na abhyupaiti jñānaṃ ananta labhate jinakośagañjam | dhyānena kāmaguṇa utsṛjate jugupsyān vidyā abhijña abhinirharate samādhim
apraheyā dharmā anāsravāḥ | teṣām apratisaṃkhyānirodhasya bhāvanāheyā prāptiḥ anāryaprāptasya ca pratisaṃkhyānirodhasya |tasyaivāryamārgaprāptasyānāsravā ’heyā mārgasatyasya ca |
sa evādīnavaḥ | tasmād dvābhyāṃ gantavyaṃ jīrṇena vā jarādurbalenā glānena vā aprayogakṣameṇa |
evaṃ bhavatu | dattāni |
yeṣāṃ samnicayo nāsti ye parijñātabhojanāḥ | śunyatā cānimittaṃ ca vivekaś caiva gocaraḥ | ākāśaiva śakuntānāṃ padaṃ teṣāṃ duranvayam
bhagavān āha | santi jīvaka te doṣāḥ | ye cyutā na srutāḥ santi | srutā na cyutāḥ santi | srutāś cyutāś ca santi | naiva srutā na cyutā iti |
rājā kathayati | mamāpi viśākhayopasthānaṃ kṛtam aham apy āryakāṃ pṛṣṭvā tāṃ bhaginīm udghoṣayāmi |
ṛju paśyet sadā sattvāṃś cakṣuṣā saṃpibann iva | etān eva samāśritya buddhatvaṃ me bhaviṣyati
ameyā raśmayo yadvad vyamiśrā bhānumaṇḍale | sadaikakāryā vartante lokam ālokayanti ca
ātmā tv ihātmano nāthaḥ ko nu nāthaḥ paro bhavet | ātmanā hi sudāntena sarvaṃ chindati bandhanam
tāta rājaputreṇa sarvaśilpāni śikṣitavyāni |
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ pūrvaṃ samanujño bhūtvā tataḥ paścād evaṃ vaded yathā saṃstutikayāyuṣmantaḥ sāṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇatam ātmanaḥ paudgalikaṃ pariṇāmayantīti pāyantikā |

tataḥ paścāt punar api tad vimānaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ tā āpsarasaḥ prādurbhūtāḥ | sa ca puruṣo ’bhirūpo darśanīyaprāsādiko ’ṅgadakuṇḍalavicitramālyābharaṇānulepanas tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍati ramate paricārayati |
atha doṣo ’yam āgantuḥ sattvāḥ prakṛtipeśalāḥ | yathāpy ayuktas tatkopaḥ kaṭudhūme yathāmbare
sa tena pratigupte pradeśe sthāpitaḥ |
tad yathā kāye kāyānupaśyanā smṛtyupasthānam;vedanāyāṃ vedanānupaśyanā smṛtyupasthānām;citte cittānupaśyanā smṛtyupasthānam;dharmeṣu dharmānupaśyanā smṛtyupasthānam.
yatha māyakārapuruṣasya na eva bhoti te śiṣya māṃ janata so ca karoti kāryam | paśyanti taṃ vividha kāryu nidarśayantaṃ na ca tasya kāyu na pi citta na nāmadheyam
niruddhe cet phalaṃ hetau hetoḥ saṃkramaṇaṃ bhavet | pūrvajātasya hetoś ca punarjanma prasajyate
yatra ṣaḍ vottare vā bhikṣavaḥ prativasanti, tair jñaptiṃ kṛtvā pravārayitavyam. pravārako bhikṣuḥ saṃmantavyaḥ. glānasya pravāraṇā grahītavyā.

column2: uddānam | kālaṃ kurvanty utkṣiptakā miśrakāṇāṃ ca bhājanam | utkṣiptaśramaṇoddeśā usārayanti mriyante ca ||
sa dṛṣṭvā pṛcchati | amba tāta kasyaiṣa stūpa iti |
eṣām aṣṭādaśadhātūnāṃ kati kuśalāḥ katy akuśalāḥ katy avyākṛtā |
caittā dvau saṃvarau teṣāṃ cetaso lakṣaṇāni ca | cittānuvarttinaḥ

svadhātuta iti bhāvāṅgād ālayavijñānataḥ | dvayābhāsā iti grāhyagrāhakābhāsāḥ | sahāvidyayā kleśaiś ca vṛttir eṣāṃ ta ime sāvidyākleśavṛttayaḥ | dvayadravyavivarjitā iti grāhyadravyeṇa grāhakadravyeṇa ca | evaṃ kleśaḥ paryeṣitavyaḥ |
atha śreṇikasya abhutī parivrājakasya jñānopalambhu na hi skandhavibhāvanā ca | yo bodhisattva parijānati eva dharmāṃ na ca nirvṛtiṃ spṛśati so viharāti prajñām
pṛthak pṛthak dhyānaṃ tribhūmikaṃ tatra
sārdhaṃvihārī (sārdhaṃvihārin)
naivāntarīk se na samudra madhye na parvatānāṃ vivaraṃ praviśya | na vidyate ’sau pṛthivī pradeśo yatra sthitaṃ na prasaheta mṛtyuḥ
puṣpāṇy eva pracinvantaṃ vyāsaktamanasaṃ naram | atṛptam eva kāmeṣu tv antakaḥ kurute vaśam
bhikṣupaiśunyāt pāyantikā |
yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānan sabhojane kule anupraskandyāsane niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pāyantikā ||
tatra katama ekāyano mārgaḥ?
sthaviro subhūti paripṛcchati lokanāthaṃ araṇāya liṅga bhaṇahī guṇasāgarāṇām | avivartiyā yatha bhavanti mahānubhāvā tāṃ vyākuruṣva jinaguṇāna pradeśamātram
sarvārthapratibhāsatvaṃ tataś citte prapaśyati | prahīno grāhyanivikṣepas tadā tasya bhavaty asau
śrotraghrāṇajihvākāyamanaḥsaṃsparśajā vedanā sukhāpi duḥkhāpy aduḥkhāsukhāpi
aparaṃ naiva śakyate bhājayitum alpaṃ kṛtvā |
aśavalam (asavalitam)
yathā upagatakānām āvāsī upagatakānupagatakān bhikṣūn bhojayitveti nava paryāyāḥ | evam anupagatakānām āvāsī upagatakān bhikṣūn bhojayitveti nava paryāyāḥ |
āsvādam alpaṃ viṣayeṣu matvā saṃyojanotkarṣam atṛptim eva | sadbhyaś ca garhāṃ niyataṃ ca pāpaṃ kaḥ kāmasaṃjñaṃ viṣam ādadīta
daśāhaparamaṃ bhikṣuṇā atirekapātraṃ dhārayitavyaṃ tata uttaraṃ paridhārayen naisargikā pāyantikā |
sa cel labhed vai nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ loke caran sādhu hi nityam eva | abhibhūya sarvāṇi parisravāṇi careta tenāptamanā smṛtātmā
evaṃ śūnyeṣu dharmeṣu kiṃ labdhaṃ kiṃ hṛtaṃ bhavet | satkṛtaḥ paribhūto vā kena kaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati
te tv alpaṃ bhāṣante |bhagavān āha | nātyalpo bhāṣitavyaḥ | api tu parimaṇḍalo bhāṣitavyaḥ |
aprāptir anivṛtāvyākṛtaiva sarvā | adhvabhedena punaḥ
sā kathayati | jihremi |

anyāpohaḥ śabdārthaḥ
avivartikā ye bhavi bodhisattvā analpakā yathariva gaṅgavālikāḥ | ananyacittāś ca vicintayeyusteṣāṃ pi cāsmin viṣayo na vidyate
yathā māyā yathā svapno gandharvanagaraṃ yathā | tathotpādas tathā sthānaṃ tathā bhaṅga udāhṛtam
iṣvastraśikṣita yathā puruṣodha kāṇḍaṃ kṣepitva anya puna kāṇḍa paraspareṇa | patanāya tasya purimasya na deya bhūmim ākāṅkṣamāṇa puruṣasya pateya kāṇḍam
gṛhapatimahāśālakulam (gṛhapatimahāsālakulam)
janyasya janikā jātir na hetupratyayair vinā
aprāpyaiva pradīpena yadi vā nihataṃ tamaḥ | ihasthaḥ sarvalokasthaṃ sa tamo nihaniṣyati

śirasi mahāntaṃ satvabhāraṃ vinidhāya bodhisatvaḥ śithilaṃ parākramamāṇo na śobhate śataguṇaṃ hi sa vīryaṃ kartum arhati śrāvakavīryāt tathā hi svaparavavidhair vividhair atyarthaṃ baddhaḥ kleśakarmajanmasvabhāvaiḥ |
sudhvāntam api sālokaṃ sudvaidham api niścitam | sugambhīram api jñeyam uttānottānam eva te
oṃ namaḥ śrīvajrasattvāya |

udakaśuddhikā manuṣyā snānasamudācārāḥ | bhikṣur bhikṣoś cīvarakāṇi preṣayati | itaś cyutāni tatrāsaṃprāptāni | kasyaitāni naisargikāṇi | adhivāsayaty āyuṣmān śroṇaḥ koṭīkarṇa āyuṣmato mahākātyāyanasya tūṣṇīṃbhāvena |
yāvad devamanuṣyebhyaḥ suprakāśitaḥ
tathā hi satsu saṃkrāmya dharmakāyam aśeṣataḥ | tilaśo rūpakāyaṃ ca bhittvāsi parinirvṛtaḥ
varṣāśāṭīcīvaram (varṣāśāṭīcāvaram)
ye punar ime aṣṭādaśa dhātava uktās teṣāṃ kati sanidarśanāḥ katy anidarśanāḥ |
adhyavasānaṃ pratītya mātsaryaṃ '
ādhyātmaṃ tu prajānāti bahirdhā ca na paśyati | ādhyātmaphaladarśī tu sa vai ghoṣeṇa nīyate
anviṣya cādāya ca jātatarṣā yān atyajantaḥ pariyānti duḥkham | loke tṛṇolkāsadṛśeṣu teṣu kāmeṣu kasyātmavato ratiḥ syāt
na tad darśayituṃ śakyaṃ vyāhāro ’sya na vidyate | nāpy asau tādṛśaḥ kaścit sattvo lokasmi vidyate
poṣadhaḥ katamaḥ |yo vo mayā bhikṣavo prātimokṣasūtroddeśa uddiṣṭaḥ sa vo ’dyāgreṇānvardhamāsam uddeṣṭavyaḥ |
tad bodhicittaṃ dvividhaṃ vijñātavyaṃ samāsataḥ | bodhipraṇidhicittaṃ ca bodhiprasthānam eva ca
pratanv iva hi paśyāmi dharmatām anucintayan | sarvaṃ cāvarjitaṃ māravijayaṃ prati te jagat
purvādig unnamati
duhkhaṃ duhkhasamutpādaṃ duhkhasya samatikramam | āryaṃ cāṣṭāṅgikaṃ mārgaṃ duhkhopaśamagāminam
na taṭe na prapāte na prāgbhāre pātraṃ nirmādayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
paṭhanti (pathanta)
nātaḥ parā vañcanāsti na ca moho ’sty ataḥ paraḥ | yad īdṛśaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prāpya nābhyastaṃ kuśalaṃ mayā
yat kuśalamūlahetoḥ sarvasattveṣu mahākaruṇāhetoś ca saṃskṛtam notsṛjati, buddhajñānahetor asaṃskṛte na patati.
vipāko mananākhyaś ca vijñaptir viṣayasya ca | tatrālayākhyaṃ vijñānaṃ vipākaḥ sarvabījakam
varṇārhavarṇe buddhastotre apratikārastavo nāma navamaḥ paricchedaḥ
mandabuddhyā me, bhagavan, mayāsya dharmaparyāyasyārthapadākṣarāṇy aparipūritāni, bhagavantam imāṃś cākṣayadharmasamanvāgatān bodhisattvān mahāsattvān ahaṃ kṣamayeyam.

yad anutpādānirodhaprabhāvitaṃ buddhatvam ity uktaṃ tat katham ihāsaṃskṛtād apravṛtti lakṣaṇād buddhatvād anābhogāpratipraśrabdham ā lokād avikalpaṃ buddhakāryaṃ pravartata iti |buddhamāhātmyadharmatām ārabhya vimatisaṃdehajātānām acintyabuddhaviṣayādhimuktisaṃjananārthaṃ tasya māhātmye ślokaḥ |
anekaṃ jāti saṃsāraṃ saṃdhāvitvā punaḥ punaḥ | gṛhakārakaiṣamāṇas tvaṃ duhkhā jātiḥ punaḥ punaḥ
yathaiva rajako vastre karmaṇe pratipadyate | pitā yathā sute bāle satvāheṭhe prapadyate
ānulomikī kṣāntiḥ
tṛṣṇābhir upaskṛtāḥ prajāḥ paridhāvanti śaśā va vāgurām | samyojanaiḥ saṅgasaktā duhkhaṃ yānti punaḥ punaś cira rātram
duḥkhe dharmajñānaṃ
dānaṃ pāramitāṣatkam āmiṣābhayadharmataḥ | ekadvayatrayeṇeha pratipat sā ’pratiṣṭhitā
sākārān sānimittān soddeśān anekavividhapūrvanivāsān anusmarati, sa ātmaparasattvapūrvāntaprabhṛti pūrvanivāsān anusmarati.

tatra katamac chraddhābalam?

jaṭī brahmāha: nūnaṃ bhadanta śāriputrasyotkūlanikūlaṃ cittam apariśuddhabuddhajñānāśayaṃ yenedṛśaṃ buddhakṣetraṃ paśyasi | ye punas te bhadanta śāriputra bodhisatvāḥ sarvasatvasamacittāḥ sarvasatvasamacittāḥ pariśuddhabuddhajñānāśayās ta imaṃ buddhakṣetraṃ pariśuddhaṃ paśyanti |
puruṣo hi jīrṇa dukhito śataviṃśavarṣo kiṃcāpi utthitu svayaṃ na prabhoti gantum | so vāmadakṣiṇadvaye puruṣe gṛhīte patanādbhayaṃ na bhavate vrajate sukhena

na svato jāyate bhāvaḥ parato naiva jāyate | na svataḥ parataś caiva jāyate jāyate kutaḥ

tais tābhyāṃ jīrṇodyānaṃ dattam | tasmin mahāśālavṛkṣaḥ |tatraikena bhagavataḥ pratimā kāritā | dvitīyena vihāraḥ pratiṣṭhāpitaḥ |tathā sthavirair api sūtrānte upanibaddhaṃ buddho bhagavān vaiśālyāṃ viharati gopasiṃhaśālavane iti |

upādiyanti skandhāni icchāśalyena vedhitāḥ | grasitā rāgaṃśalyena doṣaśalyena mūrcchitāḥ ||

ekāyanapathaśleṣād bhūmir dūraṃgamā matā |
kiṃ ca niśchadmabandhūnām aprameyopakāriṇām | sattvārādhanam utsṛjya niṣkṛtiḥ kā parā bhavet
na ca ādiśanti puruṣaiḥ striya icchakarmāṃ pravivikta prajñavarapāramitābhiyuktāḥ | kalahāvivādavigatā dṛḍhamaitracittā sarvajñakāma sada śāsani nimnacittāḥ

aprameyasamādhivikrīḍitasaṃdarśanāt buddhaparṣanmaṇḍalamadhye trividhena nirmāṇena sadā satvārthakaraṇāc ca | trividhaṃ nirmāṇaṃ śilpakarmasthānanirmāṇaṃ | vineyavaśena yatheṣṭopapattinirmāṇaṃ | uttamanirmāṇaṃ ca tuṣitabhavanavāsādikaṃ | kṣetrapariśuddhikarma ārabhya ślokaḥ |
yāvat kāmān anusaran na tṛptiṃ manaso ’dhyagāt | tato nivṛttiṃ pratipaśyamānās te vai tṛptāḥ prajñayā ye sutṛptāḥ
ela melo nāgarājā, elamelau nāgarājānau
vilumpate hi puruṣo yāvad asyopakalpate | tato ’nye taṃ vilumpanti sa viloptā vilupyate
yāvanta sattva puna tāntaka kṣetrakoṭyo te sarvi pūjana kareyur anantakalpān | divyehi puṣpavaragandhavilepanehi kalpāṃs triyadhvaparikalpa tato ’pi bhūyaḥ
bahunā vā kim uktena dṛśyatām idam antaram | svārthārthinaś ca bālasya muneś cānyārthakāriṇaḥ
deva yadi kṣāntaṃ tāny asya vṛttipadāni dīyantām |
āha: na śaknomi satpuruṣa niṣattum uccāni pragṛhitāni cemāni siṃhāsanāni |
prāg bodher deśitā dharmāḥ pravṛttisukhahetavaḥ | tato bodhim anuprāpya nivṛttisukhahetavaḥ
avighātair aviheṭhair viheṭhasaṃmarṣaṇaiḥ kriyākhedaiḥ | āvarjanaiḥ sulapitaiḥ parārtha ātmārtha etasmāt
jīvakaḥ saṃlakṣayati | kṣīṇo ’yam upādhyāyaḥ | yady eṣa etad bhaiṣajyam upayuṃkte adyaiva kālaṃ karoti |na śobhanam upādhyāyena vyupadiṣṭam | upāyasaṃvidhānaṃ kartavyam iti |
tac cittasya dṛḍhatvena kātaratvena cāgatam | duḥkhaduryodhanas tasmād bhaved abhibhaved vyathām
ekāyanaṃ sukhopāyaṃ svanubandhi niratyayam | ādimadhyāntakalyāṇaṃ tava nānyasya śāsanam
yathāpi kumbhakāreṇa mṛttikā bhājanaṃ kṛtam | sarvaṃ bhedana paryantam evaṃ martyasya jīvitam
pūrvaṃ jātir yadi bhavej jarāmaraṇam uttaram | nirjarā maraṇā jātir bhavej jāyeta cāmṛtaḥ
akartṛtvād anityatvāt sakṛtr ity apravṛttitaḥ | darśanādiṣu yatnasya svayaṃbhūtvaṃ na yujyate ||

jīvako ’pi saṃdiṣṭas tvayāpy amukasyeti |tair māṇavakair yathāsaṃdiṣṭam evānuṣṭhitam |jīvako yathāsaṃdiṣṭaṃ kṛtvā saṃlakṣayati | yady upādhyāyo ’nyasya dravyasya mūlyaṃ prakṣyati kiṃ mayā vaktavyam | sarvathā sarvadravyāṇāṃ mūlyaṃ pṛcchāmīti |
bodhicittaprayogākṣayatā, dharmadānavivaraṇaprayogākṣayatā, sattvaparipācanaprayogākṣayatā, kuśalamūlopacayaprayogākṣayatā, ime catvāro ’kṣayāḥ prayogāḥ;

pauruṣaṃ dvayoḥ

taiḥ prabhūtataraṃ ghṛtaṃ vastrāṇi ca samādhāpitāni | tenātilobhāt śvaḥ kalpo bhaviṣyatīti tad api divase na pītam | rogo ’sya prabalo jātaḥ | yāvat punar api vaidya āgatya pṛcchati |

dharmābhāvopalabdhiś ca niḥsaṃkleśaviśuddhitā | māyādisadṛśī jñeyā ākāśasadṛśī tathā
punar aparam ekam eva satyaṃ na dvitīyam asti.tatraikasatyaṃ yo ’yaṃ sarvadharmeṣv asamāropaḥ, samāropapatitānāṃ sattvānāṃ satyāvatāraṇatā.
na khalu narakavāso dhīmatāṃ sarvakālaṃ vimalavipulabodherantarāyaṃ karoti | svahitaparamaśītas tvanyayāne vikalpaḥ paramasukhavihāre ’pyantarāyaṃ karoti
kāyendriyam atrāstīti so ’yaṃ kāyendriyī | tatra navadravyāṇi | tāni cāṣṭau kāyendriyaṃ ca |
pañcabhiś cakṣurādimān |
te kathayanti | sadṛśam asmākaṃ tat kulam |kiṃ tarhi | ativiprakṛṣṭo deśaḥ |
sa saṃlakṣayati | nūnam ayaṃ devo vā nāgo vā yakṣo vā bhaviṣyati | sa kathayati | tṛṣito ’smi bubhukṣitaś ca |
śroṇasya koṭīkarṇasya mātāpitṛbhyāṃ śrutaṃ śroṇaḥ koṭīkarṇo ’bhyāgata iti |
ekasyāpi hi sattvasya hitaṃ hatvā hato bhavet | aśeṣākāśaparyantavāsināṃ kim u dehinām
pālako ’pi ' saṃlakṣayati | dāsakaḥ sārthavāhaṃ śabdāpayiṣyatīti |
tatpūrvaṃ pañcendriyavaśoddhatān | tapaḥ vratino bhikṣūn ... pañca niraikṣata

asya khalu mṛtyuvyādhijarāduḥkhavahner aśuddhāvasthāyām ayoniśomanasikārakarma kleśapūrvikā jātir indhanam ivopādānaṃ bhavati | yasya manomayātmabhāvapratilabdheṣu bodhisattveṣu śuddhāśuddhāvasthāyām atyantam anābhāsagamanād itarasyātyantam anujjvalanaṃ prajñāyate |
svapiti samāpadyate dvābhyāṃ kāraṇābhyāṃ garhyo bhavati yac cālajjitvena yac ca vaitarikatvena |
na pātreṇa vighasaṃ cchorayiṣyāmaḥ

tatra bodhisattvaḥ saṃvṛtisatyanirdeśena na parikhidyate,paramārthasatyasākṣātkaraṇe ’pi na patati;lakṣaṇasatyenaikasatyam adhigacchann api sattvān paripācayati;idam ucyate bodhisattvasya satyakauśalyam.
yad ānapekṣaḥ svaśarīrajīvite parārtham abhyeti paraṃ pariśramam | paroghātena tathāvidhaḥ kathaṃ sa duṣkṛte karmaṇi saṃpravatsyati
avismitān vismitavat spṛhayanto gataspṛhān | upāsate prāñjalayaḥ śrāvakān api te surāḥ
na phutphukārakam
prabhāvalakṣaṇavibhāge ślokaḥ | utpattivākcittaśubhāśubhaadhitatsthānaniḥsārapadā parokṣam | jñānaṃ hi sarvatragasaprabhedeṣv avyāhataṃ dhīr agataḥ prabhāvaḥ
pañcāṅgikena tūryeṇa na ratir bhavati tādṛśī | yādṛśy ekāgracittasya samyag dharmān vipaśyataḥ
yac ca varṣaśataṃ jīvet kusīdo hīnavīryavān | ekāhaṃ jīvitaṃ śreyo vīryaṃ ārabhato dṛḍham
evaṃ jino bhaṇati apratikūlabhāṇī yad ahaṃ imāya varapāramitāya āsī | tada vyākṛto ’hu parāpuruṣottamena buddho bhaviṣyasi anāgataadhvanasmin
utsṛjyāmutra gantavyaṃ sarvasvam avaśena te | dharme niyuktaṃ yāty eva purastāt sarvam eva te
bhūtaṃ padaṃ śāntamanāsravaṃ ca prajānamānāś ca prakāśayanti | deśenti dharmaṃ bahulokadhātuṣu sugatānubhāvād iyam īdṛśī kriyā
kāyaduścaritaṃ hitvā vaco duścaritāni ca | manoduścaritaṃ hitvā yac cānyad doṣasaṃhitam
adhyoṣaṇā || nirvātukāmāṃś ca jinān yācayāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ | kalpān anantāṃs tiṣṭhantu mā bhūd andham idaṃ jagat
śataṃ sarvabalānāṃ visaṃjñāvatir nāmocyate
lābhī hy alābhī dhīsaṃsthitaś ca boddhānuboddhā pratideśakaś ca | nirjalpabuddhir hatamānamānī hy apakkasaṃpakkamatiś ca dhīmān
niḥsattvāḥ sarvadharmāḥ
nāglānā utthitā uccāraprasrāvaṃ kariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā |
sarvābhāvād abhāvasya sadbhāvān nābhilāpyataḥ | abhilāpaprayogāc ca dharmasaṃjñā caturvidhā ||
tayā bandhakaṃ gṛhītam | śastraṃ dattam |te taṃ praghātayitum ārabdhāḥ |
atha khalu samantaśrīsamudgatatejorājo bodhisattvo buddhādhiṣṭhānena daśa diśo vyavalokya tasyāṃ velāyām imā gāthā abhāṣata
citrito ’nuvyañjanaiḥ
yathā raśmīnāṃ meghādyāvaraṇam aprabhāsena | tathā buddhajñānānām āvaraṇaṃ satvānām ābhājanatvena duṣṭatā pañcakaṣāyātyutsadatayā |
tasmād adhīraṃ capalapramādi navaṃ vayas tāvad idaṃ vyapaitu | kāmasya pūrvaṃ hi vayaḥ śaravyaṃ na śakyate rakṣitum indriyebhyaḥ

śayanāsanaprajñaptiṃ kṛtvā gaṇḍīm ākoṭya pṛṣṭavācikayā bhikṣūṃ samanuyujya sarvasaṃghe sanniṣaṇṇe sannipatita ekena bhikṣuṇā pṛṣṭavyaṃ |utsahasi tvam evaṃnāmā saṃghasya prahāṇaṃ pratijāgartuṃ |tena vaktavyam utsahe |

caturvidho bhūmīnāṃ lābhaḥ | adhimuktilābho yathoktādhimuktito ’dhimukticaryābhūmau | caritalābho daśasu dharmacariteṣu ca vartanāt tasyām eva | parmārthaprativedhato ca bhūmipraveśe | niṣpattilābhaś cānvinivartanīyabhūmipraveśe | caryāvibhāge ślokaḥ ṣaḍpādaḥ |
evaṃ vidyād upādānaṃ vyutsargād iti karmaṇaḥ | kartuś ca karmakartṛbhyāṃ śeṣān bhāvān vibhāvayet
tagaraṃ palāśapattreṇa yo naro hy upanahyati | pattrāṇy api sugandhīni sad evaṃ saṃgamāt satām
yaḥ śāsanaṃ hy arhatāṃ āryāṇāṃ dharmajīvinām | pratikrośati durmedhā dṛṣṭiṃ nihśritya pāpikām
anena pañcamena sarvagatatve ’pyabhājanabhūteṣu satveṣu abuddhabimbadarśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntena sādhayati |
amadyapānaṃ svājīvo ’vihiṃsā dānam ādarāt | pūjyapūjā ca maitrī ca dharma eṣa samāsataḥ

paṃcabhir karaṇair apratiniḥsṛṣṭe pāpake dṛṣṭigate utkṣepaṇīyakarmakṛta osārayitavyaḥ |katamaiḥ paṃcabhiḥ | utkacaprakacaḥ saṃghe roma pātayati pūrvavad yāvad ekena bhikṣuṇā jñaptiṃ kṛtvā karma kartavyaṃ |
manojalpair yathoktārthaprasannasya pradhāraṇāt | arthakhyānasya jalpāc ca nāmni sthānāc ca cetasaḥ
ekatve phalahetvoḥ syād aikyaṃ janakajanyayoḥ | pṛthaktve phalahetvoḥ syāt tulyo hetur ahetunā
nāme ... (śabdasvabhāvaṃ) hi ajānamānāḥ | ya ...
anyonyaṃ saṃgrahataḥ prabhedato dharmato nimittāc ca | ṣaṇṇāṃ pāramitānāṃ viniścayaḥ sarvathā jñeyaḥ
puṇyānumodanā || sarvāsu dikṣu saṃbuddhān prārthayāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ | dharmapradīpaṃ kurvantu mohād duḥkhaprapātinām
mahāntaṃ bhikṣuṇā vihāraṃ kārayitvā yāvad dvārakośārgalasthānād ālokasaṃjñinā bhūmiparikarmopādāya dvau vā trayo vā chedanaparyāyāḥ saharitāḥ adhiṣṭhātavyāḥ tata uttari adhitiṣṭhet pāyantikā |
mīmāṃsāsamādhiprahāṇasaṃskārasamanvāgata ṛddhipādaḥ
alpakaṃ pi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ duhkhāya parataḥ sadā | mahate bhavaty anarthāya viṣaṃ koṣṭhagataṃ yathā
citraṃ mahadviśuddhaṃ ca uttarottarabhūmiṣu | ā bodher bodhisatvānāṃ svaparārthaprasādhakaṃ
caittā ity ucyante | ka ime caittāḥ |
śabdas tv aṣṭavidhaḥ
idaṃ na prāptam ārabdham idam ardhakṛtaṃ sthitam | akasmān mṛtyur āyāto hā hato ’smīti cintayan
śrāddhatvād bhajate dharmaṃ prājñatvād vetti tattvataḥ | prajñā pradhānaṃ tv anayoḥ śraddhā pūrvaṃgamāsya tu
bhaveṣv eva hi sajyanta eke śramaṇabrāhmaṇāḥ | antareṇa viṣīdanti aprāpyaivottamaṃ padam
catvāraḥ pratisaṃvidaḥ

buddhajñānāntargamāt sattvarāśes tannairmalyasyādvayatvāt prakṛtyā | bauddhe gotre tatphalasyopacārād uktāḥ sarve dehino buddhagarbhāḥ saṃbuddhakāyaspharaṇāt tathatāvyatibhedāt | gotrataś ca sadā sarve buddhagarbhāḥ śarīriṇaḥ
dharmādharmau na vidyete kriyādīnām asaṃbhave | dharme cāsaty adharme ca phalaṃ tajjaṃ na vidyate
kaścit siṣeve rataye na kāmaṃ kāmārtham arthaṃ na jugopa kaścit | kaścid dhanārthaṃ na cacāra dharmaṃ dharmāya kaścin na cakāra hiṃsām
paratreṣṭaphalecchā ca śubhavṛttāv ihaiva ca | nirvāṇecchā ca dhīrāṇāṃ satveṣv āśaya iṣyate | aśuddhaś ca viśuddhaś ca suviśuddhaḥ sarvabhūmiṣu
atha katamo dharmaḥ katibhiḥ pratyayair utpadyate |
nāsty ātmasamaṃ prema | tenābhyupagatam |
abhūm atītam adhvānam ity etan nopapadyate | yo hi janmasu pūrveṣu sa eva na bhavaty ayam
kalpate tavaivaṃ kartum | amitrāṇāṃ pādaṃ gale datvā |
nodguṇṭhikayā (nodguṣṭhikayā)
athāyuṣmāñ śāriputro vimalakīrtiṃ licchavim etad avocat:kutas tvaṃ kulaputra cyutvehopapannaḥ |
nākāśaṃ vidyate kiṃcit pūrvam ākāśalakṣaṇāt | alakṣaṇaṃ prasajyeta syāt pūrvaṃ yadi lakṣaṇāt
kecid vadanty ātmanimittam eva prādurbhavaṃ caiva bhavakṣayaṃ ca | prādurbhavaṃ tu pravadanty ayatnād yatnena mokṣādhigamaṃ bruvanti
ekavācikāyāṃ pravāraṇāyām vāci bhāṣyamāṇāyāṃ aparyavasitāyāṃ pravāraṇāṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ pravāraṇāsthāpanam.
balaseno nāma gṛhapatiḥ saṃlakṣayati | kīdṛśena ' yānena śroṇaḥ koṭīkarṇo yāsyati |
antyāṣṭakād ṛte | daurmanasyāc ca
nānātvasaṃjñā saṃjñā yā rāgadveṣatamovṛtā | amanaskāram āhus taṃ yac cittasyānavekṣaṇam
yadi śūnyam idaṃ sarvam udayo nāsti na vyayaḥ | prahāṇād vā nirodhād vā kasya nirvāṇam iṣyate
sarvanirodhavirodhasaṃpraśamano nāma samādhiḥ
viṣahyam aviṣahyaṃ vety avadhūya vicāraṇām | svayam abhyupapannaṃ te nirākrandam idaṃ jagat
trividho ’nubhavo vedanāskandhaḥ | sukho duḥkho ’duḥkhāsukhaś ca |sa punar bhidyamānaḥ ṣaḍ vedanākāyāḥ cakṣuḥsaṃsparśajā vedanā yāvan manaḥsaṃsparśajā vedaneti |
ahaṃkāras tathā skandhān upādāyopalabhyate | na ca kaś cit sa tattvena svamukhapratibimbavat
yadi tāthāgatā dharmāḥ syur ime sanidarśanāḥ | nākāśe ’py avakāśaḥ syād guṇānāṃ te guṇārṇava
ahaṃ viśeyaṃ jvalitaṃ hutāśanaṃ na cākṛtārthaḥ praviśeyam ālayam | iti pratijñāṃ sa cakāra garvito yatheṣṭam utthāya ca nirmamo yayau
jñānapratisaraṇena bhavitavyaṃ na vijñānapratisaraṇena
bhagavān āha | yaḥ kaścid ādīnavo bhikṣavo ’nimantritāḥ parakīye lābhe saṃnipatanti | tasmān na bhikṣuṇānimantritena parakīye lābhe saṃnipatitavyam | saṃnipatati | sātisāro bhavati |
anyatamasmin karvaṭake gṛhapatiḥ | tena vihāraḥ kāritaḥ | tatra bhikṣuśataṃ vārṣā upagatam |
vyavasthānāvikalpena jñānena sahacāriṇā | anudharmaṃ caraty evaṃ pariśiṣṭāsu bhūmiṣu
vyañjanam iti yāvaraṇāvaraṇīyadharmāṇāṃ saṃdarśanā, artha iti yo ’nāvaraṇajñānavimokṣaḥ.
daśa bhūmīr virajasaḥ pūrayitvānupūrveṇa | balāni daśa ca prāpya jinatām arpayiṣyanti
suvarṇakeyūravidaṣṭabāhavo maṇipradīpojjvalacitramaulayaḥ | nṛparṣayas tāṃ hi gatiṃ gatā makhaiḥ śrameṇa yām eva maharṣayo yayuḥ
athaiṣāṃ hetūnāṃ katamo hetuḥ kasmin kāle phalaṃ pratigṛhṇāti dadāti vā |
kisaraṃ ca parittaṃ ca tac ca duhkhena samyutam | udake daṇḍarājīva kṣipram eva vinaśyati

samucchinnakuśamūlo niḥśubhaḥ | sa sarvālpair aṣṭābhir indriyaiḥ samanvāgataḥ |pañcabhir vedanāādibhiḥ kāyamanojīvitaiś ca |vedanā hi vit vedayata iti kṛtvā | vedanaṃ vā vit |yathā saṃpadanaṃ saṃpat | yathā ca niḥśubhaḥ sarvālpair aṣṭābhir indriyair yuktaḥ
bhikṣur bhikṣoś cīvarakāṇi preṣayati itaś cyutāni tatrāsaṃprāptāni na kasyacin naisargikāṇi | '
saṃkṣepeṇa pañcopadānaskandhaduḥkham
na hi santaḥ prakāśyante tvādṛśā deśanām ṛte | deśanā ca prabhūtāyāṃ nyāye siddhir ivāśritā
sarvaṃ tathyaṃ na vā tathyaṃ tathyaṃ cātathyam eva ca | naivātathyaṃ naiva tathyam etad buddhānuśāsanam
yan maya divā urabhrāḥ praghātitās tasya karmaṇo vipākena divā evaṃvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ pratyanubhavāmi |
sa kathayaty ānaya iti |
tāv ubhau nyāyataḥ pṛṣṭvā dhātusāmyaṃ parasparam | dāravyor medhyayor vṛṣyoḥ śucau deśe niṣedatuḥ
ayaṃ bodhisattvasyākṣayaḥ prajñāsaṃbhāraḥ.
rāgād yadi bhavet pūrvaṃ rakto rāgatiraskṛtaḥ | taṃ pratītya bhaved rāgo rakte rāgo bhavet sati
bhindanti dehaṃ praviśanty avīcīṃ yeṣāṃ kṛte tatra kṛte kṛtaṃ syāt | mahāpakāriṣv api tena sarvakalyāṇam evācaraṇīyam eṣu
dvayāniśritam ekeṣāṃ gambhīraṃ bhīrubhīṣaṇam | śūnyatākaruṇāgarbham ekeṣāṃ bodhisādhanam
teṣāṃ ca buddhāna paraṃpareṇa dīpaṃkaraḥ paścimako abhūṣi | devātidevo ṛṣisaṃghapūjito vinītavān prāṇisahasrakoṭyaḥ
āha: viparyastāyāḥ saṃjñāyā apratiṣṭhā mūlam |
samatā sarvasatveṣu dṛṣṭiś cāpi mahātmikā | paraguṇapratikāras trayāśastir nirantaraḥ
gambhīrabuddhiṃ medhāḍhyaṃ mārgāmārgeṣu kovidam | uttamārtham anuprāptaṃ bravīmi brāhmaṇaṃ hi tam
yat kathayati agniḥ paricartavya iti |striyā bhartāgnisthānīyaḥ |bhartur āsannayā bhavitavyam | nātidūrasthayā |sāhaṃ svāminam agnivat paricarāmi |
tataḥ kumāro jarayābhibhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā narebhyaḥ pṛthagākṛtiṃ tam | uvāca saṃgrāhakam āgatāsthas tatraiva niṣkampaniviṣṭadṛṣṭiḥ
suvarṇagotravat jñeyam ameyaśubhatāśrayaḥ | jñānanirmalatāyogaprabhāvāṇāṃ ca niśrayaḥ
prathamāyāṃ vāci bhāṣitāyāṃ paryavasitāyāṃ pravāraṇāṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ pravāraṇāsthāpanam.

evam eva mahārāja satatasamitam abhimardata eva prāṇino jarāmaraṇam |evaṃ jarāmaraṇābhimardanena mahārāja puruṣapudgalena kiñcit syāt karaṇīyaṃ nānyatrārthacaryāyāḥ pūrvavad yāvad buddhānāṃ śāsane yogam āpattum iti viditvātasyāṃ velāyāṃ gāthāṃ bhāṣate |
evaṃ carantu vidu paṇḍitu bodhisattvo saṅgā uchinnu vrajate jagatī asakto | sūryo va rāhugrahamukta virocamāno agnīva yukta tṛṇakāṣṭhavanaṃ dahāti
adhivacanapraveśo nāma samādhiḥ
utpādasthitibhaṅgānām anyat saṃskṛtalakṣaṇam | asti ced anavasthaivaṃ nāsti cet te na saṃskṛtāḥ
atra śarīram evāutsṛjato yadā mano na duḥkhyate tadasya lokottaram iti saṃdarśitaṃ | eti yan mudaṃ sa tena duḥkhena tat tasya taduttaram iti tasmāl lokottarād uttaraṃ |
atha te mahāśrāvakās tasya bhagavato merupradīparājasya tathāgatasya namaskāraṃ kurvanti sma |te tatra paścāt teṣu siṃhāsaneṣu nyaṣīdan |

tathāgato ’rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ samantabhadraḥ, śāradvatīputra, na yatheha dvipratyayahetubhyām paraghoṣapratyātmayoniśomanasikārabhyāṃ samyagdṛṣṭim deśayati, te bodhisattvāḥ, śāradvatīputra, tasya tathāgatasya sahadarśanād viniścitārthataḥ ṣaḍpāramitāḥ paripūrayanti;

atha khalv āyuṣmataḥ śāriputrasyaitad abhavat kim ayam āyuṣmān subhūtiḥ sthavira ātmīyena svakena prajñāpratibhānabalādhānena svakena prajñāpratibhānabalādhiṣṭhānena bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ prajñāpāramitām upadekṣyati utāho buddhānubhāveneti?
mahānāmaḥ kathayati | iyaṃ dārikāmravanāl labdhā | bhavatv asyā āmarapālī nāmeti |
prāk pañca vārttamānārthyāt
tasmād ahaṃ stuto ’smīti prītir ātmani jāyate | tatrāpy evam asaṃbandhāt kevalaṃ śiśuceṣṭitam
niśrayāt pratipakṣāc ca avatārāt tathaiva ca | ālambanamanaskāraprāptitaś ca viśiṣyate
aśuśrūṣamāṇeṣu samacittatā
mukhadvāreṇānupraviśati sma
evaṃ dharmād apakramya hy adharmam anuvartya ca | bālo mṛtyu vaśaṃ prāptaś chinnākṣa iva śocate

bhagavān saṃlakṣayaty. ākāṃkṣanti bata me śrāvakāḥ vastralābham āmiṣalābhañ ca. yanv ahaṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ sukhasparśavihārārthaṃ datṝṇāṃ ca deyadharmaparibhogārthaṃ saptāham anujānīyāṃ. tasmād anujānāmi saptāham adhiṣṭhāya gantavyaṃ karaṇīyena.
triśatikāyāḥ prajñāpāramitāyāḥ kārikāsaptatiḥ samāptā || || kṛtir iyam āryāsaṅgapādānām iti || ||
yatha nirmito puruṣa no va adṛśyakāyo nāmena vā puna sa prajñapanāya śakyaḥ | tatha bodhisattva caramāṇu vimokṣadvāraṃ nāmena vā puna sa prajñapanāya śakyaḥ
“sucīrṇe brahmacarye ’smin mārge caiva subhāvite | tuṣṭa āyuḥkṣayāt bhavati rogasyāpagame yathā ||"
aṣṭāpadīkṛtāḥ keśā netre cāñjanarañjite | alaṃ bālasya mohāya na tu pāragaveṣiṇām
avaivarto nāma samādhiḥ

iha nandati pretya nandati kṛta puṇyo hy ubhayatra nandati | sa hi nandati sa pramodate dṛṣṭvā karma viśuddhaṃ ātmanaḥ

tatra bhagavān yakṣaṃ vajrapāṇim āmantrayate |gaccha vajrapāṇe jīvakasyārakṣāṃ kuru |
jñātvā sadoṣam ātmānaṃ parān api guṇodadhīn | ātmabhāvaparityāgaṃ parādānaṃ ca bhāvayet
yaḥ punar bhikṣur dhārmikasaṃghakaraṇīye bhikṣoś chandaṃ datvā paścād abhiṣaktaḥ kupitaś caṇḍībhūto nāttamanā kṣepadharmam āpadyeta | āhara bhikṣoś chandaṃ na te dadāmīti pāyantikā |
atyantaniṣṭhāya damāya śuddhaye saṃsārajātīmaraṇakṣayāya | anekadhātu pratiṣaṃvidhāya mārgo hy ayaṃ lokavidā prakāśitaḥ
tatra katamā pravṛttiḥ? yā vipaśyanācaryā. tatra katamā sthitiḥ? yā dharmatājñānatā.
lābhasatkārakīrtyarthi parivārārthi vā punaḥ | upasthānārthi me cittaṃ tasmāt tiṣṭhāmi kāṣṭhavat
paramam iti tato nṛpātmajas tam ṛṣijanaṃ pratinandya niryayau | vidhivad anuvidhāya te ’pi taṃ praviviśur āśramiṇas tapovanam
sukhābhimāno duḥkhasya pratīkāre yathārthataḥ | tathā duhkhābhimāno ’pi sukhasya pratighātajaḥ
steye saṃkhyātaḥ
tasmād adyaiva me śreyaś cetavyam iti niścayaḥ | jīvite ko hi viśrambho mṛtyau pratyarthini sthite
ekāsanaṃ tv ekaśayyām ekacaryām atandritaḥ | ramayec caikaṃ ātmānaṃ vaneṣv ekaḥ sadā vaset
glānopasthāyiko bhadanta bhikṣur ātmārthaṃ piṇḍakaṃ paryeṣamāṇo glānasya kṛtyaṃ hāpayati |sa madīyaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhujya saṃpādayiṣyati |
dvābhyām antarvarṣābhyām ekā vāg bhāṣitā mayā | tṛtīye ’ntarvarṣe tu tamaḥskandhaḥ pradālitaḥ ||

yāvanto nārakāḥ kecid vidyante lokadhātuṣu | sukhāvatī sukhāmodair modantāṃ teṣu dehinaḥ
yadi te nāśucau rāgaḥ kasmād āliṅgase ’param | māṃsakardamasaṃliptaṃ snāyubaddhāsthipañjaram
pūrvaṃ dānakathādyābhiś cetasy utpādya sauṣṭhavam | tato dharmo gatamale vastre raṅga ivārpitaḥ
adhyatiṣṭhad atho nāthaḥ svanāmāpy avalokitaḥ | parṣacchāradyabhayam apy apanetuṃ janasya hi

uktaṃ bhagavatā saptāham adhiṣṭhāya gantavyaṃ karaṇīyeneti. bhikṣavo na jānate kasya karaṇīyaṃ. etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti.bhagavān āha / upāsakasya karaṇīyena upāsikāyāḥ karaṇīyena bhikṣoḥ karaṇīyena bhikṣuṇyāḥ śikṣamāṇāyāḥ śrāmaṇerakasya śrāmaṇerikāyāḥ karaṇīyena.

kopārtham evam evāhaṃ narakeṣu sahasraśaḥ | kārito ’smi na cātmārthaḥ parārtho vā kṛto mayā

durmaṅkūnāṃ pudgalānāṃ nigrahāya (durmaṅgubhūtānām pudgalānāṃ nigrahāya, durmadgubhūtānām pudgalānāṃ nigrahāya)
draṣṭavyo dharmato buddho dharmakāyas tathāgataḥ dharmatā cāpy avijñeyā na sā śakyaṃ vijānitum ||
yāvan navānāṃ māsānām atyayād āmrapālī prasūtā | dārako jātaḥ | abhirūpo darśanīyaḥ prāsādiko yāvad unnītaś carito mahān saṃvṛttaḥ |
